notes.title: July Update Celebration Event
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes.
This is Eyedentity Games.
 
We have a new event to help you strengthen your characters! You will have a chance to get 3 Legendary Rune Dragon’s Wraths and the Varnak Crest. Additionally, if you have this season’s summer costume, you may get a cute gesture! Please see the event details below!!
 
 
[Event 1] Daily Combo
 
Event Period: July 13 after update -> July 27 before maintenance 
 
Use 10,000 ET / EC every day for a chance to get Legendary Rune Dragon’s Wraths!
Every day, 1 lucky user will win 3 Legendary Rune Dragon’s Wraths and be the luckiest user of the day!
 (If you use 10,000 ET / EC on July 13th, you will be the luckiest user of July 14th.)
Not enough? We’ll make the deal even sweeter! This time, you will receive guaranteed items if you use at least 10,000 ET / EC a day!
You will receive Dragon Egg x 5 + Blue Courier Bird x 5 + Magnifying Glass x 5 + Item Protection Jelly x 5

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7a579e916be1eabdf5180d193909e4cbee8fad42.png


[Event 2] Varnak, the Bright and Sweet
 
Event Period: July 13 after update -> July 27 before maintenance
 
Acquire the Bright Sweet Wave Sound Set!
You will receive 1 Varnak Crest if you can collect 1 full set of Sweet Wave Sound (Wings + Tail + Decal)
You can only get the Varnak Crest once per account.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d23a9005aafa6ac1a44e260eda1127ef53bd2e15.png

Wave Sound Set Image and Stats

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b354bc2453ff1e9d10907164853948b8adb84475.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e9381e39a9a0dcde76de37d883c47572b944c15d.png
Varnak Crest


[Event 3] Summer Gesture
 
Event Period: July 13 after update -> August before update (Specific Date will be updated)
 
During the event period, if you purchase this season’s Summer Costume (including weapon pieces), you will receive the Shy Gesture
You can get as many gestures as you want! The number of gestures that you receive will be the same as the number of costumes that you buy.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/33cc6f5cc65a1dd59949cdd00726ef84f88fe310.png
Summer Costume

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7496abf8ac35c5c3b6561a7781625f27d5e53441.png
Gesture - Shy


NOTE
- For Event 1, you must USE 10,000 ET / EC to get Bonus Reward. If you only charge 10,000 ET / EC, you will not be eligible to get the bonus reward.
- For Event 1, you can use 10,000 ET / EC that was charged before July 13. This means that if you had 150,000 ET / EC on your account before the event, you could spend 10,000 ET / EC every day to qualify for the event. ET / EC that is charged and used after July 13 will also qualify for the event, but don’t forget you must USE 10,000 ET / EC. If you only charge 10,000 ET / EC, you are not eligible to get the reward.
- Event 2 or 3’s rewards will be sent on the first maintenance date after the event period ends.

-----

notes.title: Assassin Awakening Patch Notes 13 July
notes.notes:
Changelogs
 
- Assassin Awakening
- Rune Dragon Nest (4-man Normal/Hardcore)
- Summer Event
- Balancing
- Dragon Vault Updates

-----

1) Assassin Awakening
 
Awakening Quest: New Power Beckons
 
At level 90, you can accept the awakening quest from Saint Haven's Priestess of Darkness Mocha.
However, you must have already finished the 2nd Specialization to be able to take this quest.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1c0ae8c1272eb5c797dd079fce2093794fc17cc7.png

After completing the related quests, the "Awakening" skill tab will be accessible via the skill window [K], and you may proceed to add the new Awakening Skills.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/95cd3c0cb044759f883e9d96ad19b10ea98589af.png

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Assassin

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/41b0e370cbb904a803055fdb143c2d5fb0de835c.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7dcb9ac047c62941a8cf7ee2f3696377bfa58b17.png

Awakening - Assassin

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5d32ad8221dc838e1fba7c3445d4558a35b63af2.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9801adc13edd4b6f3eaa5e28514045ba8cbf7c21.pngReaper

Beast Swipe (Active) : A succession of powerful kicks as the character advances forward.
 
Flame Drag (Active) : Retreats with a somersault and attacks enemies. The attacks that follow can be used while advancing forward or retreating to the back. A functional attack skill.
 
[Awakened Passive] Shadow Hand : When a location other than the front part of the enemies is hit, Shadow Hand is enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Burning Coal : Ash deals additional hits when Burning Coal is used.
 
[Awakened Passive] Counter Attack : When enemy’s attack is evaded with Tumble, attack power of certain skills that are used next are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Crippling Punisher : Crippling Punisher enhances Beast Swipe and can summon all Ash.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f96e3165a8509c1c46468b8e76caa8f8c3d83f8c.pngRaven

Crow Storm (Active) : A skill that can only be used when enough successive skills have been used. It pulls enemies and charges forward to deal powerful damage.
 
Guillotine Cross (Active) : A skill that can only be used when enough successive skills have been used. A bunch of Chain Sickles advances forward on the ground to attack enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Star Combination : Additional Throwing Knives are thrown when Throwing Knife skill is used to gain skill resources.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chain Combination : Additional Chain Sickle is wielded when Chain Sickle skill is used to gain skill resources and it also has a chance of throwing additional Throwing Knives in succession.
 
[Awakened Passive] Edged Fan : Edged Fan returns and you will gain skill resources.
 
[Awakened Passive] Assassinate : When Crow's Deadfall hits enemies accurately, Excess Chain is enhanced.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/43390fec939c1f3ad07f263ae650dc7f921a0320.pngAbyss Walker

Abyss Claw (Active) : Continuously hits nearby enemies and also attacks some enemies behind them by shooting fangs.
 
Killing Wave (Active) : Shoots a ball that hits enemies in front continuously.
 
[Awakened Passive] Line of Darkness : Attack power is enhanced and you can return to the original position before charging.
 
[Awakened Passive] Illusion Strike : While the skill is being casted, you can change the location and shoot one more time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Summon Shadow : Shadow is absorbed to enhance oneself.
 
[Awakened Passive] Dark Conviction : Ball of Fire remains on the ground to deal continuous damage on enemies and targets can be set to concentrate the attacks.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fc446274c80bd4d2e51ec25ec711f21cfd345d4d.pngLight Bringer

Chakra Grip (Active) : A simple front attack skill for Light Fury who had fancy skills but lacked simple attack skills.
 
Unseen Art (Active) : Light Chakra spreads on the ground and reacts to certain skills to deal damage on enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Piercing Star : A simple attack skill that enhances Piercing Star.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chakra Illusion : Chakra Illusion’s functionality and attack power are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Quantum Trance : Aerial teleport ability that can be used for survival and for following with other skills.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chakra Miracle : Healing ability is enhanced when Light Fury’s attack power is enhanced.

-----

2) Rune Dragon Nest (4-man Normal/Hardcore)

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Assassin

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/41b0e370cbb904a803055fdb143c2d5fb0de835c.png

Beast Swipe (Active) : A succession of powerful kicks as the character advances forward.

Crow Storm (Active) : A skill that can only be used when enough successive skills have been used. It pulls enemies and charges forward to deal powerful damage.
 
Guillotine Cross (Active) : A skill that can only be used when enough successive skills have been used. A bunch of Chain Sickles advances forward on the ground to attack enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Star Combination : Additional Throwing Knives are thrown when Throwing Knife skill is used to gain skill resources.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chain Combination : Additional Chain Sickle is wielded when Chain Sickle skill is used to gain skill resources and it also has a chance of throwing additional Throwing Knives in succession.
 
[Awakened Passive] Edged Fan : Edged Fan returns and you will gain skill resources.
 
[Awakened Passive] Assassinate : When Crow's Deadfall hits enemies accurately, Excess Chain is enhanced.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/43390fec939c1f3ad07f263ae650dc7f921a0320.pngAbyss Walker

Abyss Claw (Active) : Continuously hits nearby enemies and also attacks some enemies behind them by shooting fangs.
 
Killing Wave (Active) : Shoots a ball that hits enemies in front continuously.
 
[Awakened Passive] Line of Darkness : Attack power is enhanced and you can return to the original position before charging.
 
[Awakened Passive] Illusion Strike : While the skill is being casted, you can change the location and shoot one more time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Summon Shadow : Shadow is absorbed to enhance oneself.
 
[Awakened Passive] Dark Conviction : Ball of Fire remains on the ground to deal continuous damage on enemies and targets can be set to concentrate the attacks.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fc446274c80bd4d2e51ec25ec711f21cfd345d4d.pngLight Bringer

Chakra Grip (Active) : A simple front attack skill for Light Fury who had fancy skills but lacked simple attack skills.
 
Unseen Art (Active) : Light Chakra spreads on the ground and reacts to certain skills to deal damage on enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Piercing Star : A simple attack skill that enhances Piercing Star.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chakra Illusion : Chakra Illusion’s functionality and attack power are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Quantum Trance : Aerial teleport ability that can be used for survival and for following with other skills.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chakra Miracle : Healing ability is enhanced when Light Fury’s attack power is enhanced.

notes.title: Deep Sea Dragon Nest Patch Notes 13th April
notes.notes:
Changelogs
 
- Deep Sea Dragon Nest
- Dark Banquet Hardcore
- Changes and Addition
A) Lv93 Unique Evolution
B) Lv93 Legend Ice Dragon Equipment Evolution
C) Refined Genesis Accessories
D) Lv93 Dragon Gem Enhancement +14
E) Changes in Guild Master Appointment system
F) Guild Join Request
G) Point Currency System
H) Epic Talisman Evolution
I) Colosseum Rank Reward Improvements
J) Mentor system changes
K) Channel Chat Improvements
L) ATK/HP Notation
M) Evolution Legend Weapon & Legend Main Weapon Converter
N) Courier Bird block function
O) Changes to Dungeon Tab in Social Window
- Others
- Dragon Vault Updates
- Skill Balancing

-----

1) Deep Sea Dragon Nest

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9bf53be85685077b55bb77ce5bd92d449ae91ef4.png

Entry Info 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1ed1c1d681b18f80eb4f1ba7ca4b59a66c956edd.png

Quest

Quest name: Ensemble of the Deep Sea, Nightmare, and Curse

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8d67d0bec313c891228248e123a5167c50eba67b.png

You can get the quest from Frye the Explorer in Saint Haven.

Rewards

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/39383f86217be6398464cb038aa2685eef6a0666.png

-----

2) Dark Banquet Hardcore

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/19c1e424e7a8330aa0f2a07b94595a99bc86987f.png

Entry Info

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bfda463d2953e3e84767bb8410d0a1fa3ebfca29.png

Quest

Quest name: Invitation to Dark Banquet

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d77c7facf804dc8e7c7949d79eef4bbd7d6a061d.png


You can accept the quest via the Remote Quest tab of your Quest Window

Mechanics
 
Dark Banquet is a special dungeon consisting of 12 floors. The goal is to fight your way up from the 1st floor, and each floor poses different challenges that you have to overcome.
 
The rewards offered gets better with each floor cleared, but so does the difficulty. Should you die in the dungeon, you will not be rewarded. It is up to you to decide if you wish to climb higher for better rewards or leave the dungeon at certain checkpoints with what you have.
 
Rules
 
- Your HP/MP will be fully recovered when you clear a floor
- Your HP/MP will be fully recovered, and dead teammates will be revived when a boss floor is cleared.
- When all players die, the dungeon will end.
- Heroes and Potions cannot be used in Dark Banquet.
- Stats are equalized in Dark Banquet. 
 
Structure
 
Dark Banquet consists of Normal Floors and Boss Floors.
In every Normal Floor, you will play one of two possible dungeons.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e0d3f779ae53ef767e17b656598eb8022737bbfd.png

Rewards

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/08d05b168ab91eee5fd9e46f7750b1c27aefa7c4.png

- Attribute Talismans are a durational talisman of different grades - Low Grade (3 days), Medium Grade (7 days) and High Grade (30 Days).
- In their pouch form, they can be traded. However, once the pouch is opened the contents are no longer tradeable.

-----

3) Changes and Addition
 
A) Lv 93 Unique Evolution

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/261308f0832df136652a8d19512daf7757965fd2.png

Level 93 Theano Equipment can now be evolved into Unique grade versions. 
Like all evolutions, Evolution Hammer is required, and all existing Enhancement Levels will be transferred as well.
Evolution Hammer can be crafted at the Blacksmith NPC.
 
 
B) Lv93 Legend Ice Dragon Equipment Evolution

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c188e50775e5e16d03a2e7c1e56f9c51fb46851b.png

Legend grade Ice Dragon equipment can now be Evolved to stronger versions, and existing enhancement levels will be transferred as well.
Evolution Hammer for Ice Dragon Legend equipment has been added to the Blacksmith NPC.
 
 
C) Refined Genesis Accessories

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8c9591292eff4c063776933a92ee40e57a7b9891.png

Genesis accessories can now be further enhanced into Refined Genesis accessories via the Blacksmith NPC.
Refined Genesis accessories require level 90 Genesis accessories as materials, as well as Ascension cube, which can be obtained in Deep Sea Dragon Nest.
 
 
D) Lv93 Dragon Gem Enhancement +14

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/35cdd1cb92222f5eaaa9824b5108fbc88783b1b0.jpg

The max enhancement level for Lv93 Dragon Gems has been increased to 14.
 
 
E) Changes in Guild Master Appointment system

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7c3ba604d5fa3f9d1210ba7eb2ce94c98e5b952a.png

In order to appoint another player as a Guild Master, you now have to type the words "Appoint Guild Master" in the above window.
 
 
F) Guild Join Request

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/30570eadc5712c56aceb5b47db05f9b48cc55411.jpg

If a character who is not in a guild wishes to receive Guild Invitations, he may Register Join Request and give a brief self-introduction about himself. 
Once registered, authorized guild members view a list of players who Registered Join Request, and send them an invitation to the guild, or a private message.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/743a637e971340ed3246619797e3a78597f81d99.png


G) Point Currency System
 
All currencies in the game has now been unified into the Point Currency System, which can be view in the character window.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c70d15e11665483e7f3e293a439c509be4299ec4.png

You can select up to 3 different points in the checkboxes, and they will be registered in the inventory window for quicker viewing.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0e9ad4f3d053cf0536e668ced51273c8b5a3c567.png

You may then use the points at the respective stores for purchasing items. By hovering over the points, a tooltip will appear which will give additional info on the merchant that uses that currency.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6aae2a6c4a7bd2be968d5127b25ef21a884da05e.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/65e827d27c9b87efe5f425d7838a379617e478f2.png

With this system in place, some currency items will be changed into points. When you obtain the following items, they will be registered as points, and will no longer appear in your inventory.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0121d7bfe8ddf9ea511a29002765ebf8875f9bdc.png

Existing currencies in your inventory can be exchanged for points at Scholar Stashy.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3b7b7bf18d07c3f70991e7dd095e50ec1599adb8.png


H) Epic Talisman Evolution

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1b8ff0561b93e8f8eb0ea53e85406cf7503bb6ee.png

You can now use Talisman Evolution Cube to evolve Rare Talismans to Epic Talismans.
Additional options of the Rare Talisman will be transferred to the Epic Talisman.
Talisman Evolution Cube can be purchase at the Nightmare Star Shop.
 
 
I) Colosseum Rank Reward Improvements
 
You may now access the Ladder Elite Store from Arena Quartermaster Vincent in Saint Haven.
 
Items sold at the store has also been changed. New items have been added, and purchase restrictions on some items has also changed.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ce2d6fd4bae63df8fe967d2119b840881b564ed2.png


J) Mentor system changes
 
- You can now register other players as a Mentor or Pupil as long as there is a difference of 1 level.
- Pupils can now be up to level 92.
- Graduation level for pupils is now changed to level 93. Pupils at level 93 can also choose to graduate immediately or not.
- Pupils will start to accumulate Graduation Points when they reached max level. Once Graduation Points has reached its limit, the pupil will graduate autommatically.
- When max leveled pupils clear nests with their mentors, they get more Mentor Points.
- Level up rewards has been changed. When the pupil reaches level 30, 60, 90 and 93, both Mentor and Pupil will get [Mentor Points] item via mail.
- Mentor points can be earned when both Mentor and Pupil clear dungeons in a party. The points can be spent at Crest Scholar Stashy.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2712d5e3ebcf7bf2d22a5030ae428eeb30f3b3ee.jpg


- Respect Points has been removed.
- Mentors can register a self-introduction using the Share Intro button in the Mentor UI. Once registered, characters without a Mentor are able to see a list of available Mentors.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9138f079a64463ae1c712b5182a57f2962084b0a.png


K) Channel Chat Improvements
 
Channel chat system has undergone a renewal.
Channel chat used to be reset every maintenance. This has changed such that it will be reset near maintenance date when more than 30 days have passed since the last person entered the channel.
 
You can now see a list of chat channels via the Social UI, under the Channel Chat tab.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b0f710130b9f5b997100820d9d2a274622147429.png

When you create a channel, you may choose to make it public and visible on the channel list, or make it private. The settings can be changed by going to the Channel Settings (Only channel masters has the authority)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bd0600a581f98892b9c2ba98475a69f00e0fb3a9.png

If you are participating in a channel chat, the Channel Tab in your chat window will remain active.


L) ATK/HP Notation

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5b11b4a342632f0c0819cc9b7ffa752467a664ad.png

Nest entry info window will now show the recommended ATK and HP required to attempt the nest.
If the recommended stats are higher than the stats you have, it will be shown in Red. If your stats are higher than the recommended stats, it will be shown in Green.
 
 
M) Evolution Legend Weapon & Legend Main Weapon Converter
 
The Legend Ice Dragon Main Weapon Converter can now be used on Evolution Ice Dragon Weapons.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3c1c4764cff0f038b1bd15065db12e12d7ce6687.png


N) Courier Bird block function

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03141ecaa70376214796934034c20d3025394600.png

A "Block" option has been added to the popup menu when you click on the character name of a player who used Courier Bird. Once blocked, their Courier Bird messages will no longer appear in your chat window.
 
 
O) Changes to Dungeon Tab in Social Window

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/88d1281e86172b272ab8cccb527e25ef4f6dd9b7.png

In the Social window, the "Dungeon" tab has been renamed to "Attempts".
The number of Nest and Dungeons that has reached their clear limits will now be reflected in the main headings.

-----

4) Others
 
- When you buy Adventurer's Bag and Extra Storage, they will no longer be automatically applied. Instead, they will now be added into your cash inventory under the Usable tab.
- The expansions can now be used as long as you have at least 1 expandable slot. I.e. If you have a 30-slot bag, but you only have 15 slots left to expand, you will be able to use it to expand the remaining 15 slots (Max inventory slots is still 150)
 
- Unlock condition for NPC Irine has been changed to "Enter [Calderock Pass] or [Saint Haven]".
 
Arena EXP Reset
 
Due to the Arena Reward and Arena System's upgrade, we've decided to reset Arena EXP in June's update.
Reset schedule has yet to be finalized, but we will announce the reset of Arena EXP 1 month before it takes place.
As compensation for the reset, we will reward the following to the top 100 ranks:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8a7d00b5268c5a3abe3dadabf9872bde8e987a23.png

-----

5) Dragon Vault Updates
 
Egyptian Costume Set

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f33fa8daeebdf14bb6160b2ef2d013549d3c6b67.png

*Far Far Away Costume Set will be removed from the Dragon Vault
 
 
Conversion Egg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b7eb747c75355c631993faa403df16c2c9ec1b4e.png

Conversion Egg is a special Dragon Egg which has a chance to give a Magical Conversion Thread.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01e1f7f1fdd04533fee0145f24e0785b6ee7b89e.png

The Magical Conversion Thread can be used to exchange for Conversion Costumes at NPC Cassie.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/247ea3a07580ceae384320bd0c265723c82838a4.png

Conversion costumes possesses powerful stats, and at the same time allows you adopt the appearance of other cash costumes. 
Once you have a Conversion Costume exchanged from Cassie, head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC (Near Manager Trisha).
 
How to use Conversion Costumes
 
1) Firstly, equip the conversion costume you have exchanged from NPC Cassie

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4d616455958ab3f3c56db236faa8a13d9396f148.png

2) Head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC, found near Manager Trisha

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2053f74795f37c81b2a77bd428c8057821c65ca7.png

3) In the Conversion UI, select the costume which you would like to be the appearance of the Conversion Costume.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/724536a1bef9d3b0e30c439abc37df4734f227bb.png

4) Click Convert
 
5) Congratulations! You have now given your Conversion Costume an appearance!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c592d76fe4bd35e5bbf5a5af6c5aa6919534de.png

This process does not destroy your appearance costume. You can reverse this process by going to the Magical Costume Mirror, and you can get back the appearance costume. You can even select another costume to use as the appearance at any time.


Dragon Egg
 
Saber Leo Tiger and Reckless Wukong Spirit has been added to the Dragon Egg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8e5e14f55a8ae8c7291f39f8efbba10802b4365f.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b8e84399caad0a1458b43ac99e72f8b5cea0c3e7.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cc0077bf41a96ccfd0363896c86944345ec231d7.png

*Rajuul Egg and Rajuul Weapon Egg will be removed from the Dragon Vault in this update.

-----

6) Skill Balancing
 
*Work-in-progress*

You can select up to 3 different points in the checkboxes, and they will be registered in the inventory window for quicker viewing.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0e9ad4f3d053cf0536e668ced51273c8b5a3c567.png

You may then use the points at the respective stores for purchasing items. By hovering over the points, a tooltip will appear which will give additional info on the merchant that uses that currency.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6aae2a6c4a7bd2be968d5127b25ef21a884da05e.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/65e827d27c9b87efe5f425d7838a379617e478f2.png

With this system in place, some currency items will be changed into points. When you obtain the following items, they will be registered as points, and will no longer appear in your inventory.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0121d7bfe8ddf9ea511a29002765ebf8875f9bdc.png

Existing currencies in your inventory can be exchanged for points at Scholar Stashy.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3b7b7bf18d07c3f70991e7dd095e50ec1599adb8.png


H) Epic Talisman Evolution

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1b8ff0561b93e8f8eb0ea53e85406cf7503bb6ee.png

You can now use Talisman Evolution Cube to evolve Rare Talismans to Epic Talismans.
Additional options of the Rare Talisman will be transferred to the Epic Talisman.
Talisman Evolution Cube can be purchase at the Nightmare Star Shop.
 
 
I) Colosseum Rank Reward Improvements
 
You may now access the Ladder Elite Store from Arena Quartermaster Vincent in Saint Haven.
 
Items sold at the store has also been changed. New items have been added, and purchase restrictions on some items has also changed.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ce2d6fd4bae63df8fe967d2119b840881b564ed2.png


J) Mentor system changes
 
- You can now register other players as a Mentor or Pupil as long as there is a difference of 1 level.
- Pupils can now be up to level 92.
- Graduation level for pupils is now changed to level 93. Pupils at level 93 can also choose to graduate immediately or not.
- Pupils will start to accumulate Graduation Points when they reached max level. Once Graduation Points has reached its limit, the pupil will graduate autommatically.
- When max leveled pupils clear nests with their mentors, they get more Mentor Points.
- Level up rewards has been changed. When the pupil reaches level 30, 60, 90 and 93, both Mentor and Pupil will get [Mentor Points] item via mail.
- Mentor points can be earned when both Mentor and Pupil clear dungeons in a party. The points can be spent at Crest Scholar Stashy.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2712d5e3ebcf7bf2d22a5030ae428eeb30f3b3ee.jpg


- Respect Points has been removed.
- Mentors can register a self-introduction using the Share Intro button in the Mentor UI. Once registered, characters without a Mentor are able to see a list of available Mentors.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9138f079a64463ae1c712b5182a57f2962084b0a.png


K) Channel Chat Improvements
 
Channel chat system has undergone a renewal.
Channel chat used to be reset every maintenance. This has changed such that it will be reset near maintenance date when more than 30 days have passed since the last person entered the channel.
 
You can now see a list of chat channels via the Social UI, under the Channel Chat tab.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b0f710130b9f5b997100820d9d2a274622147429.png

When you create a channel, you may choose to make it public and visible on the channel list, or make it private. The settings can be changed by going to the Channel Settings (Only channel masters has the authority)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bd0600a581f98892b9c2ba98475a69f00e0fb3a9.png

If you are participating in a channel chat, the Channel Tab in your chat window will remain active.


L) ATK/HP Notation

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5b11b4a342632f0c0819cc9b7ffa752467a664ad.png

Nest entry info window will now show the recommended ATK and HP required to attempt the nest.
If the recommended stats are higher than the stats you have, it will be shown in Red. If your stats are higher than the recommended stats, it will be shown in Green.
 
 
M) Evolution Legend Weapon & Legend Main Weapon Converter
 
The Legend Ice Dragon Main Weapon Converter can now be used on Evolution Ice Dragon Weapons.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3c1c4764cff0f038b1bd15065db12e12d7ce6687.png


N) Courier Bird block function

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03141ecaa70376214796934034c20d3025394600.png

A "Block" option has been added to the popup menu when you click on the character name of a player who used Courier Bird. Once blocked, their Courier Bird messages will no longer appear in your chat window.
 
 
O) Changes to Dungeon Tab in Social Window

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/88d1281e86172b272ab8cccb527e25ef4f6dd9b7.png

In the Social window, the "Dungeon" tab has been renamed to "Attempts".
The number of Nest and Dungeons that has reached their clear limits will now be reflected in the main headings.

-----

4) Others
 
- When you buy Adventurer's Bag and Extra Storage, they will no longer be automatically applied. Instead, they will now be added into your cash inventory under the Usable tab.
- The expansions can now be used as long as you have at least 1 expandable slot. I.e. If you have a 30-slot bag, but you only have 15 slots left to expand, you will be able to use it to expand the remaining 15 slots (Max inventory slots is still 150)
 
- Unlock condition for NPC Irine has been changed to "Enter [Calderock Pass] or [Saint Haven]".
 
Arena EXP Reset
 
Due to the Arena Reward and Arena System's upgrade, we've decided to reset Arena EXP in June's update.
Reset schedule has yet to be finalized, but we will announce the reset of Arena EXP 1 month before it takes place.
As compensation for the reset, we will reward the following to the top 100 ranks:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8a7d00b5268c5a3abe3dadabf9872bde8e987a23.png

-----

5) Dragon Vault Updates
 
Egyptian Costume Set

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f33fa8daeebdf14bb6160b2ef2d013549d3c6b67.png

*Far Far Away Costume Set will be removed from the Dragon Vault
 
 
Conversion Egg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b7eb747c75355c631993faa403df16c2c9ec1b4e.png

Conversion Egg is a special Dragon Egg which has a chance to give a Magical Conversion Thread.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01e1f7f1fdd04533fee0145f24e0785b6ee7b89e.png

The Magical Conversion Thread can be used to exchange for Conversion Costumes at NPC Cassie.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/247ea3a07580ceae384320bd0c265723c82838a4.png

Conversion costumes possesses powerful stats, and at the same time allows you adopt the appearance of other cash costumes. 
Once you have a Conversion Costume exchanged from Cassie, head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC (Near Manager Trisha).
 
How to use Conversion Costumes
 
1) Firstly, equip the conversion costume you have exchanged from NPC Cassie

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4d616455958ab3f3c56db236faa8a13d9396f148.png

2) Head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC, found near Manager Trisha

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2053f74795f37c81b2a77bd428c8057821c65ca7.png

3) In the Conversion UI, select the costume which you would like to be the appearance of the Conversion Costume.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/724536a1bef9d3b0e30c439abc37df4734f227bb.png

4) Click Convert
 
5) Congratulations! You have now given your Conversion Costume an appearance!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c592d76fe4bd35e5bbf5a5af6c5aa6919534de.png

This process does not destroy your appearance costume. You can reverse this process by going to the Magical Costume Mirror, and you can get back the appearance costume. You can even select another costume to use as the appearance at any time.


Dragon Egg
 
Saber Leo Tiger and Reckless Wukong Spirit has been added to the Dragon Egg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8e5e14f55a8ae8c7291f39f8efbba10802b4365f.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b8e84399caad0a1458b43ac99e72f8b5cea0c3e7.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cc0077bf41a96ccfd0363896c86944345ec231d7.png

*Rajuul Egg and Rajuul Weapon Egg will be removed from the Dragon Vault in this update.

-----

6) Skill Balancing
 
*Work-in-progress*

notes.title: Kali Awakening Patch Notes 16th March
notes.notes:
Changelogs
 
- Kali Awakening
- Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)
- Changes and Additions
A) Genesis Earrings
B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
C) Gold Pouch Content Added
D) Save Chat Feature
E) Simplified Damage Display
F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
G) PVP Guild Missions Added
H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
I) Heraldry UI Improvements
J) Granom Nest Changes
K) Daredevil Faire Changes
- Dragon Vault Updates
- Skill Balancing

-----------------------------------------------------

1) Kali Awakening
 
 
Awakening Quest: New Power Beckons
 
At level 90, you can accept the awakening quest from Saint Haven's Priestess of Darkness Mocha.
However, you must have already finished the 2nd Specialization to be able to take this quest.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f18fbd729af23389abd2015cfb47424274ba8c51.png

After completing the related quests, the "Awakening" skill tab will be accessible via the skill window [K], and you may proceed to add the new Awakening Skills.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a1a69887b43710430c8e29c61d6f9a8338a12eb9.png

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Kali

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c43d24bc0d266fdf14a982ae6a091a09033a381c.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/839705bc03ce3f359c876ad4c37e0a744820acf7.jpg


Awakening - Kali

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/149393e0d115bacdf3ededc6118f1fdb8e9b3979.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09de25095fba0c76381b1f365859a5e13ec35a53.pngDark Summoner

Deadly Claw : Temporarily enhances Phantom Claw
Shattering Hand : A powerful charging skill using Spirit Hand
[Awakening Passive] Phantom Claw : Number of hits is increased and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit
[Awakening Passive] Resent Area : Cooldown is shortened and critical rate increases for a period of time
[Awakening Passive] Rampage Claw : Rampage Claw’s last attack is enhanced and action speed increases
[Awakening Passive] Chaos Formation : Chaos Formation’s number of hits increases and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/98205cd857f9f5c03d43bf3620c8032dc5c452d5.pngSoul Eater

Summon Totem : Summons a totem in front to curse enemies constantly and enhance oneself
Soul Liberation : Absorbed souls are released to deal powerful damage
[Awakening Passive] Soul Eater : Absorbs souls regularly and recovers own HP
[Awakening Passive] Cling Snake : When Cling Snake hits enemies accurately, cooldown of own skills are recovered
[Awakening Passive] Soul Scream : When Soul Scream hits enemies accurately, the character absorbs additional souls
[Awakening Passive] Specter of Pain : Additional ghosts of pain are summoned for Branded targets

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/911c1c1f6dbea2f09322028c2d61dda2a6cab24a.pngBlade Dancer

Grazing Rush : Throws Chakram in front to paralyze enemies and the character charges in front to deal damage
Blade Step : Uses Chakram to attack and deal powerful damage on nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Graze Dance : Skill speed slows down and the ball pulls nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Sweet Circle : Attack power increases and when the skill hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Breeze Call is recovered
[Awakening Passive] Elegant Storm : Number of hits increases and cooldown is shortened
[Awakening Passive] Squall Flaker : When it hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Graze Dance and Sweet Circle are recovered


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5973a4891c0c696052cbe303512d7e3943d78113.pngSpirit Dancer

Acanthus : Acanthus is summoned to slash enemies and charges in front
Crushing Hammer : Crushing Hammer is summoned to attack by leaping forward after a spin attack
[Awakening Passive] Dusk Hunter : Number of arrows increases and cooldown is saved
[Awakening Passive] Illusion Dance : Cooldown is shortened and earns second turn
[Awakening Passive] Wide Stinger : Attack power increases and recovers cooldown when it hits enemies accurately

----------

2) Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03e128618b42edda4ebf898cf6c80d19487fc0e6.png

Entry Info

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/213cf72b46c03ad9f42a58c50e5fab95291e5651.png

The goal is to kill monsters to fill the Nightmare Gauge and attain Nightmare Stars.
 
Events occur at random when the Nightmare Gauge is 50% and 100% filled. Clearing these random events will award you with much more Nightmare Stars.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/342d36c946d8c7d616b0f8135f9861ae74a0b076.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b98a64f8f8bd9d63e9b848088c131daeda8ba369.png

Rewards
 
Upon defeating the boss at Nightmare Level 4, a reward chest will appear in the centre of the map.
You'll be able to attain items such as Level 93 Magic Talismans and Garnets from the Treasure Chest.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/de79ef581a00fddde792433f227059d15c209eed.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/54768ccd32fe3ae30f8e2a66a4fb94d14be42667.png

Changes in Nightmare Store

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ed4f22fc09a1e7d868e4759119b65561c49a5c34.png

----------

3) Changes and Additions
 
 
A) Genesis Earrings
 
Genesis Earrings can now be crafted via the Blacksmith's Crafting Menu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7e85bc5eead617bd9191c9ac21880fc70a607067.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f86fd2cfc1f6b21ad69ffce9f73f9c111d52f460.png

To craft Genesis Earrings, you will need Harmony Cubes.
Harmony Cubes can be obtained from Level 93 4-Player Hardcore Nests.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96b567b697a8d92daf761531064c29d5d2c76045.png


B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
 
Restrictions on item purchase in Ladder Store is no longer based on Ladder Score, but on Rank Tiers no

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/19001ac4cd125ec7c8ac0213b9e5a88f9d8a63ac.png



C) Gold Pouch Content Added
 
Rarestones can be obtained from Gold Pouches at a very low rate.
The value of these Rarestones is dependent on the Gold Pouch's grade

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4794f2d2b416bd276aa22b051bbd6973a8c479fd.png


D) Save Chat Feature
 
A feature that allows you to save your chats into a text file has been added.
 
[How to save chats]
 
Click on the chat settings icon at the top-left of the chat window

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/28f5d9cbb1e52a59f05c3f53a960494f8de018fb.png

You will see a "Save Chat" button.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c86137dc700e0cfb0fe7982f5a42fd5bc333b462.png

The chat will be saved to the directory /Documents/Dragonnest/Chat 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5957ae42f79b2f7eb6a5139ee0bcdc0ce06bf755.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/26fdce0e7f62060c6276baafb9a4c4b7cd1b1c90.png


E) Simplified Damage Display
 
Damage values display has been simplified.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5176d54fb4d1a010ce14996c95a4201b9384af27.png

Comma is added for damage values with more than 4 digits

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/29dc8e6a1907df461e950731c48f1206986f59ae.png

For values than 6 digits or more, the last 3 digits will be replaced with a "K".
This option can be turned on or off via the game settings, by checking the "Numeric Abbreviation" box.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c0de5815efdbc3bf0c0b35f367e09c21c34b8aa2.png

Finally, the total damage accumulated from combos will be shown in the screen once the combo is over.
Damages not counted towards combo such as burn and poisoning will not be included in the total damage.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6444dfbc67559d4588ae5c28cf3544cdd4b9093c.png


F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
 
Quest notification has been added for Specialization and Awakening when they are available so that players won’t miss them out.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/46f87b51c59561fddadf1b38f00f0c462152416e.png

If there is a Specialization/Awakening quest available, a notification will appear at the top of the quickslots upon entering town.
When the "Receive Quest" is selected, the quest will be attained immediately.

To help players better distinguish Specialization/Awakening quests, quest icons on minimaps and above quest NPCs will be changed

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/eb2e168167f549fc05df2a8721c44d6e252eb9bf.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04729ece554f0fff3eb1531f8f0a35e41ea5cd1b.png


Specialization/Awakening quest in the quest guide will also be of a different color

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d278e5f6553008d8ca1ae60a8227422653d4615e.png

Specialization/Awakening quests have been separated into another tab in the quest window. You can now view them in the Remote Quest tab in the quest window.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f3e5ad0446c57e0590b55426b03517a40b73dd65.png


G) PVP Guild Missions Added
 
Guild missions have been added so players can now earn Guild Points when they win in [Colosseum mission room] and [Rank Battle].

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/17c2a40357724a9e4b3a1bbab5eb909e1c76d863.png


H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
 
If there is a difference between next level’s skill cooldown and current level’s skill cooldown, it will be shown in [Next Level Effect] in the skill tooltip. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3f17e0ca694100210a35518a97e9b2cf0aba3e37.png


I) Heraldry UI Improvements
 
Returning and destroying Heraldries can now be done in the same way as other items.
[Craft Heraldry] and [Return Heraldry] have been removed from Heraldry Scholar NPC.
 
Return Heraldry
Right Click on the equipped heraldry to unequip it (fees apply)
 
Destroy Heraldry
Drag and drop heraldry outside the inventory window to discard it.
 
Change Heraldry
When you try to equip the same type of heraldry as one that is already equipped, it will be replaced with the new heraldry (fees apply).


J) Granom Nest Changes
 
Normal Mode
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- At Stage 4’s line pattern, ghosts that should be protected by the players will appear
 
Hardcore
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- Damage will be lowered when players fail the line pattern in all stages of Hard Core.
 
Stage 4 line pattern improvements
 
- Ghost’s HP gauge has been changed to green.
- Damage received when ghost disintegrates has been lowered.
- The problem of nicknames not being shown has been fixed.


K) Daredevil Faire Store
 
- Level 93 Chaos Fellowship Heraldry has been added.
- Level 90 Chaos Fellowship Heraldry cannot be purchased anymore.

----------

4) Dragon Vault Updates
 
Far Far Away Costume Set

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6aa65fa7354235a5b9edeb53e3a91fd110b755c7.jpg


Rajuul Hero Weapon Egg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0ce4d2b71a25b13c6be7605d5b465e3bd1100b14.png

- Chance to obtain Brilliant Hero's Weapon Exchange Coupon from this special Dragon Egg (Note that this is a different Dragon Egg from the Rajuul Dragon Egg release in the previous patch).
- You can exchange for Brilliant Hero's weapon series from NPC Pania in Saint Haven

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cfc2c098b428a99c4c38433736d61e49ad6e1e9a.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/87539893d052098c05226f2511f25ebc3dd8df67.jpg


Dragon Egg
 
Silver Dragon's Butterfly Earrings and Silver Dragon's Butterfly Necklace has been added to the Dragon Egg.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09105cca7d5ab17bb9c696f14aa6424baf9aeaf3.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9cee4bc6c3805b211efdd563e400c7f5bf765e26.jpg


New Ally - Foxy Fox
 
A new growth pet has been added to the cash shop.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6660160607b9a62d3c6c0f630514cde86c1a173b.png

2 pet accessories has also been added for Foxy Fox
- Dignity Fox Crown
- Progressive Goggle Set

-----------

5) Skill Balancing
 
Awakening Character Skill Balancing
 
Kali
Phantom Guard (PVE, PVP): Phantom Guard is improved.
- MP is no longer deducted when Kali takes damage.
- Reduction in received damage is reduced from 26% to 20%.
Phantom Guard (PVE): Phantom Guard is improved.
- Increase in Super Armour DEF is reduced from 200% to 50%.
- Duration is reduced from 29 seconds to 20 seconds.
Phantom Guard (PVP): Phantom Guard is improved.
- Duration is reduced from 14.5 seconds to 10 seconds.
 
Screamer
Blitz Claw (PVE, PVP): [Phantom’s Rage] is removed from pre-requisites for learning this skill.
Rampage Claw (PVE, PVP): Increase in stun rate is removed.
Rampage Claw (PVE): Additional damage on targets immune to stun is removed.
Rampage Claw (PVE): Attack power increases
- Based on max level ATK: 1306% > 4923%
Hands of Vengeance (PVE, PVP): Reduction in cooldown due to skill level is removed and cooldown will now be based on max level
Phantom Avenger (PVE, PVP): The issue of cooldown recovery effect being applied on [Phantom Avenger] has been fixed.
Invincibility effect has been removed and skill duration is increased.
- Level 3 duration will be increased from 18 seconds to 21 seconds. (PVE)
- Level 3 duration will be increased from 9 seconds to 11 seconds. (PVP)
Phantom Avenger (PVE): Attack power decreases.

notes.title: Kali Awakening Patch Notes 16th March
notes.notes:
Changelogs
 
- Kali Awakening
- Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)
- Changes and Additions
A) Genesis Earrings
B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
C) Gold Pouch Content Added
D) Save Chat Feature
E) Simplified Damage Display
F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
G) PVP Guild Missions Added
H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
I) Heraldry UI Improvements
J) Granom Nest Changes
K) Daredevil Faire Changes
- Dragon Vault Updates
- Skill Balancing

-----------------------------------------------------

1) Kali Awakening
 
 
Awakening Quest: New Power Beckons
 
At level 90, you can accept the awakening quest from Saint Haven's Priestess of Darkness Mocha.
However, you must have already finished the 2nd Specialization to be able to take this quest.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f18fbd729af23389abd2015cfb47424274ba8c51.png

After completing the related quests, the "Awakening" skill tab will be accessible via the skill window [K], and you may proceed to add the new Awakening Skills.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a1a69887b43710430c8e29c61d6f9a8338a12eb9.png

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Kali

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c43d24bc0d266fdf14a982ae6a091a09033a381c.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/839705bc03ce3f359c876ad4c37e0a744820acf7.jpg


Awakening - Kali

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/149393e0d115bacdf3ededc6118f1fdb8e9b3979.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09de25095fba0c76381b1f365859a5e13ec35a53.pngDark Summoner

Deadly Claw : Temporarily enhances Phantom Claw
Shattering Hand : A powerful charging skill using Spirit Hand
[Awakening Passive] Phantom Claw : Number of hits is increased and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit
[Awakening Passive] Resent Area : Cooldown is shortened and critical rate increases for a period of time
[Awakening Passive] Rampage Claw : Rampage Claw’s last attack is enhanced and action speed increases
[Awakening Passive] Chaos Formation : Chaos Formation’s number of hits increases and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/98205cd857f9f5c03d43bf3620c8032dc5c452d5.pngSoul Eater

Summon Totem : Summons a totem in front to curse enemies constantly and enhance oneself
Soul Liberation : Absorbed souls are released to deal powerful damage
[Awakening Passive] Soul Eater : Absorbs souls regularly and recovers own HP
[Awakening Passive] Cling Snake : When Cling Snake hits enemies accurately, cooldown of own skills are recovered
[Awakening Passive] Soul Scream : When Soul Scream hits enemies accurately, the character absorbs additional souls
[Awakening Passive] Specter of Pain : Additional ghosts of pain are summoned for Branded targets

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/911c1c1f6dbea2f09322028c2d61dda2a6cab24a.pngBlade Dancer

Grazing Rush : Throws Chakram in front to paralyze enemies and the character charges in front to deal damage
Blade Step : Uses Chakram to attack and deal powerful damage on nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Graze Dance : Skill speed slows down and the ball pulls nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Sweet Circle : Attack power increases and when the skill hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Breeze Call is recovered
[Awakening Passive] Elegant Storm : Number of hits increases and cooldown is shortened
[Awakening Passive] Squall Flaker : When it hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Graze Dance and Sweet Circle are recovered


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5973a4891c0c696052cbe303512d7e3943d78113.pngSpirit Dancer

Acanthus : Acanthus is summoned to slash enemies and charges in front
Crushing Hammer : Crushing Hammer is summoned to attack by leaping forward after a spin attack
[Awakening Passive] Dusk Hunter : Number of arrows increases and cooldown is saved
[Awakening Passive] Illusion Dance : Cooldown is shortened and earns second turn
[Awakening Passive] Wide Stinger : Attack power increases and recovers cooldown when it hits enemies accurately

----------

2) Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03e128618b42edda4ebf898cf6c80d19487fc0e6.png

Entry Info

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/213cf72b46c03ad9f42a58c50e5fab95291e5651.png

The goal is to kill monsters to fill the Nightmare Gauge and attain Nightmare Stars.
 
Events occur at random when the Nightmare Gauge is 50% and 100% filled. Clearing these random events will award you with much more Nightmare Stars.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/342d36c946d8c7d616b0f8135f9861ae74a0b076.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b98a64f8f8bd9d63e9b848088c131daeda8ba369.png

Rewards
 
Upon defeating the boss at Nightmare Level 4, a reward chest will appear in the centre of the map.
You'll be able to attain items such as Level 93 Magic Talismans and Garnets from the Treasure Chest.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/de79ef581a00fddde792433f227059d15c209eed.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/54768ccd32fe3ae30f8e2a66a4fb94d14be42667.png

Changes in Nightmare Store

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ed4f22fc09a1e7d868e4759119b65561c49a5c34.png

----------

3) Changes and Additions
 
 
A) Genesis Earrings
 
Genesis Earrings can now be crafted via the Blacksmith's Crafting Menu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7e85bc5eead617bd9191c9ac21880fc70a607067.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f86fd2cfc1f6b21ad69ffce9f73f9c111d52f460.png

To craft Genesis Earrings, you will need Harmony Cubes.
Harmony Cubes can be obtained from Level 93 4-Player Hardcore Nests.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96b567b697a8d92daf761531064c29d5d2c76045.png


B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
 
Restrictions on item purchase in Ladder Store is no longer based on Ladder Score, but on Rank Tiers no

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/19001ac4cd125ec7c8ac0213b9e5a88f9d8a63ac.png



C) Gold Pouch Content Added
 
Rarestones can be obtained from Gold Pouches at a very low rate.
The value of these Rarestones is dependent on the Gold Pouch's grade

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4794f2d2b416bd276aa22b051bbd6973a8c479fd.png


D) Save Chat Feature
 
A feature that allows you to save your chats into a text file has been added.
 
[How to save chats]
 
Click on the chat settings icon at the top-left of the chat window

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/28f5d9cbb1e52a59f05c3f53a960494f8de018fb.png

You will see a "Save Chat" button.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c86137dc700e0cfb0fe7982f5a42fd5bc333b462.png

The chat will be saved to the directory /Documents/Dragonnest/Chat 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5957ae42f79b2f7eb6a5139ee0bcdc0ce06bf755.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/26fdce0e7f62060c6276baafb9a4c4b7cd1b1c90.png


E) Simplified Damage Display
 
Damage values display has been simplified.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5176d54fb4d1a010ce14996c95a4201b9384af27.png

Comma is added for damage values with more than 4 digits

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/29dc8e6a1907df461e950731c48f1206986f59ae.png

For values than 6 digits or more, the last 3 digits will be replaced with a "K".
This option can be turned on or off via the game settings, by checking the "Numeric Abbreviation" box.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c0de5815efdbc3bf0c0b35f367e09c21c34b8aa2.png

Finally, the total damage accumulated from combos will be shown in the screen once the combo is over.
Damages not counted towards combo such as burn and poisoning will not be included in the total damage.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6444dfbc67559d4588ae5c28cf3544cdd4b9093c.png


F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
 
Quest notification has been added for Specialization and Awakening when they are available so that players won’t miss them out.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/46f87b51c59561fddadf1b38f00f0c462152416e.png

If there is a Specialization/Awakening quest available, a notification will appear at the top of the quickslots upon entering town.
When the "Receive Quest" is selected, the quest will be attained immediately.

To help players better distinguish Specialization/Awakening quests, quest icons on minimaps and above quest NPCs will be changed

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/eb2e168167f549fc05df2a8721c44d6e252eb9bf.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04729ece554f0fff3eb1531f8f0a35e41ea5cd1b.png


Specialization/Awakening quest in the quest guide will also be of a different color

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d278e5f6553008d8ca1ae60a8227422653d4615e.png

Specialization/Awakening quests have been separated into another tab in the quest window. You can now view them in the Remote Quest tab in the quest window.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f3e5ad0446c57e0590b55426b03517a40b73dd65.png


G) PVP Guild Missions Added
 
Guild missions have been added so players can now earn Guild Points when they win in [Colosseum mission room] and [Rank Battle].

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/17c2a40357724a9e4b3a1bbab5eb909e1c76d863.png


H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
 
If there is a difference between next level’s skill cooldown and current level’s skill cooldown, it will be shown in [Next Level Effect] in the skill tooltip. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3f17e0ca694100210a35518a97e9b2cf0aba3e37.png


I) Heraldry UI Improvements
 
Returning and destroying Heraldries can now be done in the same way as other items.
[Craft Heraldry] and [Return Heraldry] have been removed from Heraldry Scholar NPC.
 
Return Heraldry
Right Click on the equipped heraldry to unequip it (fees apply)
 
Destroy Heraldry
Drag and drop heraldry outside the inventory window to discard it.
 
Change Heraldry
When you try to equip the same type of heraldry as one that is already equipped, it will be replaced with the new heraldry (fees apply).


J) Granom Nest Changes
 
Normal Mode
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- At Stage 4’s line pattern, ghosts that should be protected by the players will appear
 
Hardcore
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- Damage will be lowered when players fail the line pattern in all stages of Hard Core.
 
Stage 4 line pattern improvements
 
- Ghost’s HP gauge has been changed to green.
- Damage received when ghost disintegrates has been lowered.
- The problem of nicknames not being shown has been fixed.


K) Daredevil Faire Store
 
- Level 93 Chaos Fellowship Heraldry has been added.
- Level 90 Chaos Fellowship Heraldry cannot be purchased anymore.

----------

Far Far Away Costume Set

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6aa65fa7354235a5b9edeb53e3a91fd110b755c7.jpg


Rajuul Hero Weapon Egg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/87539893d052098c05226f2511f25ebc3dd8df67.jpg


Dragon Egg
 
Silver Dragon's Butterfly Earrings and Silver Dragon's Butterfly Necklace has been added to the Dragon Egg.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09105cca7d5ab17bb9c696f14aa6424baf9aeaf3.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9cee4bc6c3805b211efdd563e400c7f5bf765e26.jpg


New Ally - Foxy Fox
 
A new growth pet has been added to the cash shop.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6660160607b9a62d3c6c0f630514cde86c1a173b.png

notes.notes:

1) Granom Nest (Normal / Hardcore)

Rewards

Achievements
You may attain the following achievements and titles by clearing Granom Nest:
 
Normal
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/57579003d14ccb6052df0c5ddf4ea1b88ebf70cd.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/80d9d3ced967b8efedbff2ee3ab8224cfaa9b630.png

Hardcore
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01c14b4ecc6fe86a471caeedb34c69daf4ac3f33.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bd1ab5d6592eb5b237db25eb5048d6021dce3aa9.png


2) Rumble Mode
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/341f1a05598c51c1ca2eb528f88cb7a5797fe34a.png

Rumble Mode Changes
- Monster level has been increased to Lv93.
- HP of all monsters (except boss monsters) has been slightly increased.
- A buff that periodically recovers MP will be applied when you enter.
 
Entry Info
1) Press the Matching key (Default: Insert key) or click on the Matching Icon to open the Matching UI
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2cb13c9085e0b41d1b23e52bc3698dd2cd088c2e.png

2) Click the Battlefield Tab
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/413708dce6faeea3be365e5f09c3b3c604ba2e3e.png

3) Click the Matching button to begin matching


Rumble Mode Info
- Rumble Mode is a massive PvPvE battlefield, where players have to kill monsters or players from the opposing team within the time limit.
- Up to 12 people (6 per team) can participate in each instance of Rumble Mode.
- Only level 93 characters can participate in Rumble Mode
- Schedule for Rumble Mode is as follow:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a18f7d850e3be3961cf936ec4995cb4e8fd09847.png
*Above Timings are in PST

Party Matching
- Matching can be done in a party, and the party must have at least 2 members.
- Matching request can be done only by the party leader.
 
Winning Conditions
- The team that collects 30,000 points first is declared the winner.
- If both teams does not reach 30,000 points within the time limit, the team with the higher point will be the winner.
 
Rules
- Points are obtained when monsters or enemy players are killed.
- If you are killed, your points will be deducted. If you are killed by an enemy player, the player who killed you will take the points deducted from you.
- Players with 0 points will not have any points deducted
- You lose 30% of your points if killed by an enemy player, and 50 points (fixed) if killed by a monster.
 
Points
- The following icons will be shown above your character following the amount of points you have
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3094db2705ace5b9896cd0a649f48aaab87be1d0.png

Monster Hunt
- Various Monsters roam the battlefield, and you will gain points by killing them.
- Some higher grade monsters will appear at certain intervals, which will award more points when killed.
- Certain monsters provide buffs when killed, so be mindful not to let the opponent team kill them.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a41d038ed688c44df1d77ddcc7000415ee5e8fe9.png

Surrendering
- You may surrender the round, but only after 5 minutes have passed
- To surrender, open the menu by pressing the ESC key, then click on the [Surrender] button
- You will surrender successfully if more than 70% of your team agrees
- If surrender fails, you can request for a surrender again after 1 minute.
 
Re-entry and leaving penalty
- If you are disconnected during the match, you can re-enter when you log in back into the game.
- However, if you choose not to re-enter, a leaving penalty will be imposed on you for 10 minutes.
- With the leaving penalty in effect, you are not allowed to request for Rumble Mode matching.
 
Rewards
- You will be awarded a reward pouch when you win or lose
 
Win
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/78c4cb122a73d5d4e7bad35d6c0014efe0552f4c.png 

Lose/Draw
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1b3565722eb70d894dd4b7fb61e08f9b6c8b72de.png

Enhanced Rumble Mode Title Stats
- Rumble Mode Titles' stats has been enhanced
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/69869cc0f1177d541092dae38e62bddd32ebe6bc.png

Daily/Weekly Tasks
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b47bc9241039725ba83b809c6466e31a3247d147.png

Store Rewards
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bac3a590fb4d085f6d78ab0ae72202c89bd6292d.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9bc4ca272c842d135782ef7a0344d641aec9b746.png

3) Changes & Additions
Lv93 Rare Talisman Crafting Added
- Lv93 Rare Talisman can now be crafted
- Brilliant Talisman Fragment and Brilliant Talisman Essence are needed for crafting
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ae9f48434dc6fc2d3914821359efef6da7c8da5e.png

Lv93 Skill Accessory Crafting
- Lv93 Epic Grade Skill Accessory crafting will be added to Blacksmith NPC’s crafting menu
- Obsession Theano Fragment and Brilliant Technique Fragment (Hero’s Battlefield) are needed for crafting Lv93 skill accessory.
- Obsession Theano Fragment can be obtained by disassembling Lv93 Epic Grade Obsession Theano accessories, which drops from Granom Nest
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8d7d75b5d8a97c81d7bab3e86bb9369be8543af3.png

Nest Gold Pouch Added
- Epic Grade Gold Pouch will be dropped from Granom Nest

4) Cash Shop Updates
Rajuul Costume Set
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/29fbb0cbd22b8956dd1739bcea949bef1f15176a.png

New Epic Costumes (From Costume Synthesis Tablet) - Racer Set
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/07c3cbf9ceceaecbff19a4fa56f6d6d28ab788bc.png

Rajuul Egg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e4f10f3a15f8559907010f442145daf5753284d2.jpg
- Chance to obtain Fascinating Rajuul Wing/Tail/Decal and Necklace from this special Dragon Egg (Note that Weapon coupons is not included in the egg this time round)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/141e7d394dddd88a249b2a01583cc326e223fc5f.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f780d80ef8ca989334f69d534c28da409926ac16.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/eda83d5938d530d324934aa800ebfaa3dce3b6ce.png

Dragon Egg Addition
- Ruby Lustre Dragon mount has been added into the Dragon Egg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4adee12acdb5693f8030f1f2eee689962ed5c454.png
