notes.title: Arch Heretic Patch Note 19th January
notes.notes:
1) New Class: Arch Heretic
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ba3af86999eb5591b0353d9d75e118014df4ade9.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c709f772e1becbb5b5f7f9501ad8223facc36ec7.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2fb39f2d37cdbd0f35eaac4a1e184fb149ba22d1.png

2) Lv93 Twisted Territory (Rhadames)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4e88cef34213768857340ee94662d1406ab8b15c.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/65e9ead814a78fb1f0d0ffc07423211fb7ea70a1.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8f34c669b2336c1f789a2a21dd4aff6b6fcb979a.png

3) Community System Improvements
Party Reward System Added
For a more active [Community] with active participation of new users, a system with new rewards has been added.
- [Party Reward] tab has been added to [Community (O)] window where you can get additional rewards for playing in a party.
- You can check the information on the rewards you can get for playing in a party.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f78871faecfac2ee26a136d41be0994d91c12643.png

Party Reward System Details – Accumulated Points
When you play in a party, each character can automatically get [Party Reward Points] listed in [Basic Conditions] and [Recommended Conditions].
- Basic Conditions: Each character in the party will accumulate points based on the party size and cleared location.
- Recommended Conditions : When players equipped with the title “New Hero/Chronicle Hero/Returned Hero” are inside the party, all the party members will get bonus points.
- Accumulated Party Reward Points : You can accumulate up to 10,000 Points and the accumulated points will last until 9am every Saturday.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bf7f9b671d6176d387461cd1b0b9b088bcde505e.png

Party Reward System Details – Rewarding and Reset
When [Party Reward Points] are fully accumulated, you will automatically receive a reward in your [Mailbox].
- You will see a system message on the chat window when you get the reward.
- When reward is given out, points will not be accumulated anymore and you can accumulate points again when it is reset at 9am on Saturday. (Starts from 0 points)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b101ccb70dc7a50197a3df40aa10a95138179f7b.png

4) Growth Guide Added
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4d75c2d1d0ff5521730661edbf4a67d71dee69e7.png
When your character’s level reaches the maximum, you can see the beginner’s guide about game contents before playing in a [party].
- This is a system that can only be used by characters who reached Lv93 (maximum level).
- After reaching the [max level], why not take a look at [Contents Goals] and [Equipment Collection] to enjoy the game?
* Growth guide speech bubble will not appear anymore when you achieve at least one [Contents Goal].

5) Character Selection/Creation Window Renewal And Chronicle Reopen
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/75214992ed9a4ac3780a49e31128553e60edb357.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/25647f46254a7199c0e01effa1e9b2024c80d86d.jpg
Chronicle character will be opened for creation till the next update.

6) Skill Balancing
 
All Classes
Equipment application rate is reduced in Rank Battle mode.
- Strength, Agility, Intellect, Vitality, Physical and Magic Attack Power
 
Paladin
Shield Charge: Attack power is reduced (PVP)
- ATK based on max level : 710% -> 557%
 
Guardian
Divine Barrier: Attack power is increased. (PVE)
- ATK based on max level : 933% -> 1454%
Stance of Faith EX: Cooldown is increased to 7 seconds (PVP)
[Awakening Passive] Stance of Faith: HP recovered for blocking at accurate timing is reduced to 3%. (PVP)
 
Crusader
Class Mastery II: [Electric Smite]’s Instant duration is increased by 1 second (PVE,PVP)
[Awakening Passive] Charitable Zap: God's Stigma debuff effect is applied. Sound of God's Judgement is improved (PVE,PVP)
 
Saint
[Awakening Passive] Grand Cross: Holy Explosion’s additional damage is changed to 150% (PVE,PVP)
[Awakening Passive] Grand Cross: Following is changed for [Enhanced Healing Relic]. (PVE,PVP)
- Uses 100 Bubbles
- Recovers additional HP equal to 20% of Magic ATK
Blessed Sign: Tumble is now allowed during delay action (PVE,PVP)
Blessed Sign: Attack area is slightly increased (PVE,PVP)
 
Engineer
Bullet Barrage: Uses 6 ammo now (PVE,PVP)
Chemical Warfare: Uses 3 ammo now (PVE,PVP)
 
Gear Master
Mecha-Cannon: HP of Mecha Duck regenerated after exploding is changed from 70% to 10% (PVP)
 
Shooting Star
Summon Buster: After Alfredo’s shooting, target location is changed to opponent’s location during reload. (PVE,PVP)
Summon Buster: Satellite Attack’s Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level,  4100% -> 4580%
[Awakening] Alley-oop!: Can be used by entering [Special Attack Button] after using Lock and Load EX (PVE,PVP)
[Awakening] Cannon Blaster: Reduces Bullet Barrage’s cooldown when it hits enemies (PVE)
[Awakening] Chemical Warfare: Uses 3 ammo now. (PVE,PVP)
Alfredo Drill: Command restriction duration after using the skill is changed from 10 seconds to 15 seconds (PVP)
 
Alchemist
Arctic Squish: Attack speed is slightly reduced (PVE)
Arctic Squish: Attack power is reduced (PVE,PVP)
- ATK based on max level, 1174% -> 1000%
Frosty Fist: Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 682% -> 931%
Contagion: Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 278% -> 384%
Magma Monument: Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 1348% -> 1660%
Ground Zero: Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 1660% -> 2339%
Toxic Twirl: Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 1230% -> 1607%
 
Adept
Super Slop Cocktail: Explosion ATK is changed to 350% (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 3200% -> 3733%
Ice Beam: Attack power is increased (PVE)
- ATK based on max level, 1787% -> 3137%
Elemental Flair: Maximum explosion level is changed to level 2 (PVE,PVP)
Elemental Flair: Number of hits during charging increases (PVE,PVP)
Elemental Flair: Charging time increases but will be affected by action speed in the future (PVE,PVP)
Elemental Flair: Attack power is reduced
- ATK per hit : 530% -> 441% (PVE)
- Level 1 ATK : 10600% -> 7950% (PVE)
- ATK per hit : 50% -> 42% (PVP)
- Level 1 ATK : 1000% -> 750% (PVP)
 
Physician
Class Mastery I: Increase in ATK is changed from 10% -> 13% (PVE)
Class Mastery II: Increase in ATK is changed from 13% -> 18% (PVE)
[Awakening] Injector: Increase in action speed is changed to 15% (PVE)
 
Swordsman
Halfmoon Slash: Cooldown is reduced from 48 seconds to 36 seconds (PVP)
 
Lunar Knight
Halfmoon Slash EX: Halfmoon Slash's cooldown is no longer reduced and [Magic Energy] is not used (PVE,PVP)
Moon Blade Dance EX: [Magic Energy] needed to cast the spell is reduced from 30 points to 20 points (PVE,PVP)
Class Mastery II: Halfmoon Slash Instant no longer uses [Magic Energy] (PVE,PVP)
Class Mastery II: Increase in own ATK is changed from 18% to 30% (PVE)
Class Mastery II: Increase in own ATK is changed from 5% to 12%. (PVP)
[Awakening Passive] Cyclone Slash: When you learn the skill, Cyclone Slash’s cooldown is reduced to 11 seconds (PVP)
 
Taoist
Illusion Strike: Cooldown is reduced from 17 seconds to 12 seconds (PVP)
Night Burst: Attack power is increased  (PVP)
- ATK based on max level : 329% > 421%
Nether Burst: Cooldown is reduced from 15 seconds to 10 seconds (PVP)
Nether Burst: Attack power is increased (PVP)
- ATK based on max level : 294% > 392%
Dark Line: Cooldown is reduced from 35 seconds to 30 seconds (PVP)
Dark Line: Attack power is increased (PVP)
- ATK based on max level : 421% > 727%
 
Abyss Walker
Darkness Incarnate: Increase in Dark Attribute ATK is changed from 7% to 15% (PVP)
Darkness Incarnate: Duration increases from 10 seconds to 20 seconds (PVP)
 
Raven
Class Mastery I: When [Fade] is used, Final Damage increases by 15% for 5 seconds (PVP)
Chain Punisher EX: Cooldown is reduced from 35 seconds to 25 seconds when you learn this skill (PVP)
 
Lancer
Lingering Swing: Cooldown is reduced from 12 seconds to 9 seconds (PVP)
Spear of Light: Cooldown is reduced from 18 seconds to 11 seconds (PVP)
Twirl Trance: Cooldown is reduced from 32 seconds to 24 seconds (PVP)
Erratic Power: [Fatigue] is no longer accumulated when Erratic Power is activated and it will be accumulated only when the skill is used (PVP)
Erratic Power: The name of [Lethargy] effect for [Fatigue] accumulation has been changed to [Overload] (PVP). HP will be reduce by a certain amount in [Overload] state (PVP)
Martial Spirit: [Fatigue] is no longer accumulated (PVP)
Martial Spirit: Increase in ATK is changed from 25% to 15% (PVP)
Martial Spirit: Cooldown is reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds (PVP)
Stalwart Spirit: [Fatigue] is no longer accumulated when you use the skill and removes 30 accumulated [Fatigue] (PVP)
Stalwart Spirit: Cooldown is reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds (PVP)
Stalwart Spirit: Reduction in received damage is changed from 20% to 10% (PVP)
Flag Salute: Cooldown is reduced from 20 seconds to 10 seconds (PVP)
 
Dragoon
Class Mastery I: Own STR stat increases by 50% when you learn this skill (PVE)
Class Mastery I: When you learn the skill, own STR increases by 15% (PVP)
Blackflip Pierce: The speed of stabbing with the spear increases a little and invincibility effect is removed (PVP)
Blackflip Pierce: Cooldown is reduced from 20 seconds to 8 seconds (PVP)
Spinning Takedown EX: Enter [Special Attack Button] at the accurate timing in 2nd charging state for a powerful attack.
- Enhanced Spinning Takedown ATK: 500% of Spinning Takedown’s ATK
 
Valkyrie
Class Mastery I: Own INT stat increases by 50% when you learn this skill (PVE)
Class Mastery I: When you learn the skill, own INT increases by 15% (PVP)
Dance of Light: Cooldown is reduced from 12 seconds to 5 seconds (PVP)
 
Patrona
Overclock: Increase in AGI due to [Steam] is changed from 1% per Steam to 1.7% per Steam (PVE)

7) Dragon Vault Update
Addition:
Gardener Costume Package
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b9c400b7156af302da9a96087de1f7fa18b94fa7.png

Arch Heretic's Mystic Dark Package
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ce35bc04266223104ded66c5ad17de1336406711.jpg

Dragon Egg Update:
Gold Dragon Lord
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/380abb569e082b90630372fd899cfe39ed64c399.jpg

Cold Mirage Sadnyth's Transformation Set
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d7e60d14de2aaccdde7c23a588935c8d36610343.jpg

Ice Queen Transformation
If you equip all 4 Sorrow Wings, Tail, Decal and Necklace, Costume Transformation button will appear and you can transform into Sorrow.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/66b42f82c9b5934c32f5fc085499b12e833a5cb0.jpg

8) Others
A) Skill Crest Removed
Adept's Super Slop Cocktail [Increased Debuff Duration] Crest is removed.
You cannot craft or attain the removed Crest anymore.
B) Changes in Gateway of Erosion Shop
Level requirement for buying all items in Gateway of Erosion Shop has been changed to Lv90.
C) Daily Task – Changes in Twisted Territory Target Location
Achievement condition has been changed from the old Twisted Territory to new Twisted Territory (Lv93) in [Rhadames].
D) Events Ended
Christmas Event
Dragon Hunting Day

notes.title: [Update] Us, against the Ice Dragon
notes.notes:
Dear Heroes,
 
Your bravery is indeed unmatched!
 
Even though the Ice Dragon relentlessly rose after every defeat, he has severely underestimated the unity of our brave Heroes of Altera.
 
For as long as Altera's heroes stand, nothing will ever threaten the world.
 
Below are the names of the Brave Heroes who contributed to the Server Event.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b2889255a48542a2219eb76af5e0c9becc47cb08.png

Important Notes:
- Rewards will be credited to the Special Storage on 22nd December, during the maintenance.
- Rewards are account-based (only one character can receive the reward). 
- Only level 93 characters can retrieve the rewards.
- Kindly retrieve the reward within 14 days (by 5th January 2017).

*Please note that Awakening Costumes for Warrior, Archer and Sorceress will be removed in this patch.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6e5294740eedb465a47340682a4037c29a74fec5.png Guardian
Thrust Force (Active) : Flings Divine Chain forward. Should it hit an enemy, the Cleric pulls himself towards them thus damaging them as well.
 
Overwhelm (Active) : Amplifies Holy Energy and slams the ground. Press Normal Attack right after casting the skill to spend 3 Guardian Bubbles to deal additional damage.
 
[Awakened Passive] Guardian Force : Damages enemies by shattering a Holy Shield. The shards produced as a result of the skill additionally deals damage at random locations.
 
[Awakened Passive] Armour Break : The skill changes to Light Attribute, Attack Power increases and gain an additional attack. Attain 1 Guardian Bubble when the skill hits enemies accurately.
 
[Awakened Passive] Shield Charge : Charges at a shorter distance but Attack Power is increased and the skill has changed to Light Attribute. Attack area of the final uppercut attack is greatly increased.
 
[Awakened Passive] Stance of Faith : Block enemies’ attack at the right timing to recover a certain amount of HP.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/587d28463cfa36131c352db7f6f3ac4341eeb66a.png Crusader
Mighty Blow (Active) : Jumps high up into the air and glides for a while. Attacks nearby enemies with lightning when descending. Has a chance to Electrocute enemies.
 
Hammer Hand (Active) : The Hammer Hand is summoned from the heavens to rain justice down on enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Divine Combo : The skill is changed to Light Attribute and Attack Power increases. During a combo, press the Normal Attack to shoot Holy Lightning.
 
[Awakened Passive] Holy Relic : A Holy Orb is created where the Holy Relic lands. Holy Orb Increases user's Light Attribute Attack Power.
 
[Awakened Passive] Lightning Zap : When skills related to Electrocute successfully hits enemies, Lightning Zap's cooldown is recovered by 3 seconds. The Charger state debuff will be changed to God's Stigma debuff. When the attacked target is in God's Stigma debuff state, God's Judgement lightning will strike the target after 0.5 seconds.
 
[Awakened Passive] Judge's Power : Final Damage effect is applied when the skill is used.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ab64142ecdaa4b8f8596ce273e4ddb5a9c703f08.png Saint
Antiphona Pool (Active) : Summon a Holy Orb that damages enemies and explodes at regular intervals to deal more damage.
 
Blessed Sign (Active) : Holy Energy within the body is amplified and released. The closer enemies are to the Cleric’s Holy Energy, the more damage they will receive.
 
[Awakened Passive] Lightning Relic : The relic automatically summons Small Lightning Relics nearby. Small Lightning Relics deal high damage to the area where they land and emits constant Electric Damage to enemies nearby.
 
[Awakened Passive] Grand Cross : Holy Explosion when the Grand Cross disappears deals more damage.
 
[Awakened Passive] Holy Burst : Skill is now emitted around the summoned Relic instead of the Cleric.owerful light is summoned not around the player but around the summoned relic to amplify damage.
 
[Awakened Passive] Great Heal : When Great Heal is activated, Power of Light recovers HP proportional to the user’s Magic Attack at regular intervals.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/60b27d5845d48f6f1eefda786695ed2a454e4bc3.png Inquisitor
Judgement Spear (Active) : After a short run-up, the Judgement Spear is thrown forward whereby it flies at a high speed. Targets and nearby enemies are damaged and electrocuted as a result.
 
Lightning Storm (Active) : Shoots lightning high up into the sky to summon powerful lightning clouds. Constantly creates lightning when the lightning cloud is completed which Electrocutes enemies and deals high damage. Number of lightning produced is greatly reduced, while lightning cloud remains present even when skills are used on the Cleric to cancel the action.
 
[Awakened Passive] Lightning Bolt: Attack Power is increased and when it hits enemies, the cooldown on Judgement Spear is refreshed once.
 
[Awakened Passive] Detonate: Lightning emanating from the Cleric is removed and has a 50% chance of enhancing Detonate.
 
[Awakened Passive] Avenging Wave: Attack Power is increased, while Cooldown is reduced. This skill can be activated immediately during Judgement Spear, Lightning Storm.
 
[Awakened Passive] Consecration: Light Attribute Attack Power increases when standing on Holy Power.


Awakening - Academic
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/348a1f934df16156c1c709fc26edbe8bb0514a4e.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/252de66db54b01d84404ee0d99246ba18ce0feb1.png Gear Master
Tower Recall: All summoned towers are summoned to the Academic’s location.
 
Mecha Cannon: All summoned Mecha Ducks are summoned to the Academic’s location and combines into creating a Mecha Explosive. [Awakened Passive] Tower Mastery: Academics can now summon up to 3 Engineer towers and 1 Gear Master tower.
 
[Awakened Passive] Gravity Grenade: After pulling enemies to the center of the first explosion of Gravity Grenade, a second explosion occurs. Mecha Duck and Tower aggro will increase for enemies that have been hit.
 
[Awakened Passive] Mechanic Mode: Action Speed increases and Mechanic skills such as Mechanic Gatling, Mechanic Cannon, Mechanic Ice Pump and Mechanic Chain Saw are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Mecha Duck: The maximum number of Mecha Ducks that can be summoned are increased. Additionally, the Mecha Ducks summoned have enhanced skills.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cf450d192371925d210606fad43504089daae261.png Shooting Star
Alfredo Drill: Orders Alfredo to charge in with a drill.
 
Summon Buster: Throws a marker at a target location. Alfredo is summoned next to the user and is equipped with artillery to shoot enemies near the marker.
 
[Awakened Passive] Alfredo: Alfredo summoned is bigger in size.
 
[Awakened Passive] Air Shot: Air Shot's Attack Power increases and additional attacks shoot mini bombs.
 
[Awakened Passive] Cannon Blaster: Cannon Blaster's cooldown is reduced and creates 2 explosions.
 
[Awakened Passive] Biochemical Experiment: Poisons enemies when Biochemical Experiment hits them. Poisoned enemies take more Damage.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b89c616742dbf7c1c38528f4c9e9b76409d87c0e.png Adept
Magma Jump: Jumps forward using the explosive power of magma. You can use the Direction Keys to change its direction while using this skill.
 
Elemental Flair: Creates an [Alchemy Circle] on the floor that combines Fire and Water attributes to pull enemies and induce a powerful explosion. While casting, it constantly pulls and deals damage on enemies and can cause an explosion with the [Normal Attack]. The Attack Power and Area of explosions are increased based on the casting time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Elemental Mastery: Fire and Water attribute attacks combine into an attribute that has higher Attack Power.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Palm: Summons two Ice Palms that guard the user.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Beam: Ice Beam's attack area is increased and shoots faster.
 
[Awakened Passive] Magma Wave: Damage dealt over time after Magma Wave explosions are now deal as a continuous chain of explosions.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e84131d222fccbf613f2b70775f85794f860800b.png Physician
Poison Strike: Attacks enemies with a Syringe. Syringe will break when the attack is successful and a Mini Slime Pool will be formed. The Mini Slime Pool constantly generates Poison Slime that explodes when it comes into contact with enemies.
 
Slime Pool: Summons a Slime Pool under the Academic’s feet. If there already is a Mini Slime Pool nearby, it will also turn into a Slime Pool.
 
[Awakened Passive] Disease: Number of Poison Flasks thrown are reduced to 1 but a Poison Pool will be formed when it breaks to deal damage over time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Poison Break: Additional attacks cause nearby Poison Pools to explode.
 
[Awakened Passive] Injector: When Injector is used, action speed increases and Summon Slime's cooldown is reduced when it hits enemies. Action speed increase is also applicable when it hit allies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Sacrifice: Deals damage to nearby enemies when sacrificed Slime explodes and gives Attack Power buff to allies. The buff increases recovery rate but duration is reduced.



2) Professor K Nest Remedial Class (Hardcore)
  
Professor K's Remedial Classes getting too easy?
 
He has now prepared a tougher curriculum! Are you ready for it?
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cd9cf990e33785432ea74453d17771601aad3669.jpg

Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3337dc244eba60582e3a762f73732a9056d48896.jpg
Location: Garden of Eternity > Flickering Spiral Passageway

Rewards
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fda31a714b022c2baca99c5255f8dffb9933ba50.jpg



3) 7 Practice Nests
 
7 Practice Modes has been added. 
 
Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/86b0e40905572d2ae8d38cc35a1b071d335d4f5f.jpg

Below is a list of Practice Modes added to Garden of Eternity
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8ebe3b3077ca67f8f926fc7fea2a7388815b9c43.jpg

Rewards
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/21535e83745323e453bf98fe622e0071f11f8f4f.jpg



4) X'mas Event
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8fffd8eb7b5337b98b8ca2f8db9e79db9bcb176b.jpg
Christmas is around the corner! Decorations has been put up in all of Altera to celebrate this festive season!
 
 
Santa Orc's Getaway Dungeon
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0c2de90a9a04ea8fd619aef5afc4368e48e1e788.png

Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f6dae038db2db4b0346441816487ba4084056ef6.jpg

You can enter Santa Orc's Getaway via Daredevil Faire.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/63fee8866fcba285041eed50098808000067d98d.png
Simply make Santa Orc fall by using skills or bombs that have been placed around the map. As he falls, there's a chance he may drop Santa Orc's Gift Pouch and other random debuff items.

Rewards
 
You can get one of the following items from [Santa Orc’s Gift Pouch]. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01d95cbcda0dac931d2cfdbccead64c5e0389e2a.jpg

Christmas Store
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d417f99e89eb2d4a06d0030a98b81598bada2504.png

You can spend the 2016 Christmas Exchange Coupon at NPC Cassie to buy the following items:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/08b3cd003cdc62155b49fd67960bf8d4719d4e42.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/13be43336637149802b42772677a24f078a41639.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2e6eced9d03ec65d758b0f4f1921bd0036da50ae.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04153abe2cf26f6dccd9e56d8c07bfd44068a3b0.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0b53b781b5a62a68e8d30d5cf8eed68e1238d2e1.png



5) Dragon Hunting Day
 
Hunt down Dragons every day, without worries of resurrection counts!
 
Simple click on the Dragon Hunting Icon at the bottom right of the screen during the designated hours (schedule below), and you will automatically be matched up with other Heroes.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/161d50aea10b0e8a1866bbb52d72f49c92044c3c.png
Notes:
- You cannot enter in a party.
- Dragon Hunting Day is played in "Compensation On" mode, which means your equipment does not matter in Dragon Hunting Day. All your stats are balanced (similar to Equalize in PVP).
- No reduction in durability
 
Schedule
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d54b7a1140c869d21d9d295d062667e0ec4c5603.png
*Above Timings are in PST



6) Others
 
A) Store Changes
 
Weapon Engraving Pouch has been added to the Goddess Aura Store.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c2dcbc3a2c6104e23a4e73ebdf17d9b8fa5b17fb.png
*It can be bought with 60 Goddess's Aura (2 per week), or with 40x Scroll Fragments and 5 gold (no limit)
 
 
Holy Shield skill heraldry has been removed. As such, it will no longer drop or sold at the Goddess's Sparkle Store.
 
 
B) Achievement Window
 
[Practice Mode] category has been added to the Nest tab of the achievement window.
You can find related achievements for existing and new practice mode nests there.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/961d3c7a40561d90175625c1c492df55990a85ec.png

C) Misc
 
Crafting Improvements
 
Skill Accessories equipped with Dragon Gem cannot be used as crafting materials anymore.
 
Changes in Equipment Repair Cost
 
Fixing cost for equipment will be reduced by 30% compared to the past. (All Rare grade Weapon/Armor, Epic grade Weapon/Armor below Lv80)

Changes in Hero’s Battlefield Rewards
 
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard): Special Skill Dragon Gem is removed, Goddess’s Lament x1, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x1 are added
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard Core): Goddess’s Lament x2, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x2 are added

Rock of Blessing
 
Rock of Blessing cannot be destroyed now.
Drop rate for Rock of Blessing is lowered. (Maximum quantity for each server remains the same)

Changes in Ice Dragon Stage 2 Skill
 
When Ice Dragon Stage 2 boss “Killing Machine Balapa” uses “Absorption” attack, all status effects on Balapa will be removed. (Applicable in all difficulty levels)

Changes in World Zone Resurrection Method
 
If you become a ghost in the World Zone, you can resurrect without using the Resurrection Scroll.
 
 
D) Balancing
[Work in Progress]

[Awakened Passive] Avenging Wave: Attack Power is increased, while Cooldown is reduced. This skill can be activated immediately during Judgement Spear, Lightning Storm.
 
[Awakened Passive] Consecration: Light Attribute Attack Power increases when standing on Holy Power.


Awakening - Academic

Mecha Cannon: All summoned Mecha Ducks are summoned to the Academic’s location and combines into creating a Mecha Explosive. [Awakened Passive] Tower Mastery: Academics can now summon up to 3 Engineer towers and 1 Gear Master tower.
 
[Awakened Passive] Gravity Grenade: After pulling enemies to the center of the first explosion of Gravity Grenade, a second explosion occurs. Mecha Duck and Tower aggro will increase for enemies that have been hit.
 
[Awakened Passive] Mechanic Mode: Action Speed increases and Mechanic skills such as Mechanic Gatling, Mechanic Cannon, Mechanic Ice Pump and Mechanic Chain Saw are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Mecha Duck: The maximum number of Mecha Ducks that can be summoned are increased. Additionally, the Mecha Ducks summoned have enhanced skills.

Alfredo Drill: Orders Alfredo to charge in with a drill.
 
Summon Buster: Throws a marker at a target location. Alfredo is summoned next to the user and is equipped with artillery to shoot enemies near the marker.
 
[Awakened Passive] Alfredo: Alfredo summoned is bigger in size.
 
[Awakened Passive] Air Shot: Air Shot's Attack Power increases and additional attacks shoot mini bombs.
 
[Awakened Passive] Cannon Blaster: Cannon Blaster's cooldown is reduced and creates 2 explosions.
 
[Awakened Passive] Biochemical Experiment: Poisons enemies when Biochemical Experiment hits them. Poisoned enemies take more Damage.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b89c616742dbf7c1c38528f4c9e9b76409d87c0e.png Adept
Magma Jump: Jumps forward using the explosive power of magma. You can use the Direction Keys to change its direction while using this skill.
 
Elemental Flair: Creates an [Alchemy Circle] on the floor that combines Fire and Water attributes to pull enemies and induce a powerful explosion. While casting, it constantly pulls and deals damage on enemies and can cause an explosion with the [Normal Attack]. The Attack Power and Area of explosions are increased based on the casting time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Elemental Mastery: Fire and Water attribute attacks combine into an attribute that has higher Attack Power.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Palm: Summons two Ice Palms that guard the user.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Beam: Ice Beam's attack area is increased and shoots faster.
 
[Awakened Passive] Magma Wave: Damage dealt over time after Magma Wave explosions are now deal as a continuous chain of explosions.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e84131d222fccbf613f2b70775f85794f860800b.png Physician
Poison Strike: Attacks enemies with a Syringe. Syringe will break when the attack is successful and a Mini Slime Pool will be formed. The Mini Slime Pool constantly generates Poison Slime that explodes when it comes into contact with enemies.
 
Slime Pool: Summons a Slime Pool under the Academic’s feet. If there already is a Mini Slime Pool nearby, it will also turn into a Slime Pool.
 
[Awakened Passive] Disease: Number of Poison Flasks thrown are reduced to 1 but a Poison Pool will be formed when it breaks to deal damage over time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Poison Break: Additional attacks cause nearby Poison Pools to explode.
 
[Awakened Passive] Injector: When Injector is used, action speed increases and Summon Slime's cooldown is reduced when it hits enemies. Action speed increase is also applicable when it hit allies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Sacrifice: Deals damage to nearby enemies when sacrificed Slime explodes and gives Attack Power buff to allies. The buff increases recovery rate but duration is reduced.



2) Professor K Nest Remedial Class (Hardcore)
  
Professor K's Remedial Classes getting too easy?
 
He has now prepared a tougher curriculum! Are you ready for it?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3337dc244eba60582e3a762f73732a9056d48896.jpg

Rewards
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fda31a714b022c2baca99c5255f8dffb9933ba50.jpg



3) 7 Practice Nests
 
7 Practice Modes has been added. 
 
Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/86b0e40905572d2ae8d38cc35a1b071d335d4f5f.jpg

Below is a list of Practice Modes added to Garden of Eternity
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8ebe3b3077ca67f8f926fc7fea2a7388815b9c43.jpg

Rewards
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/21535e83745323e453bf98fe622e0071f11f8f4f.jpg



4) X'mas Event
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8fffd8eb7b5337b98b8ca2f8db9e79db9bcb176b.jpg
Christmas is around the corner! Decorations has been put up in all of Altera to celebrate this festive season!
 
 
Santa Orc's Getaway Dungeon
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0c2de90a9a04ea8fd619aef5afc4368e48e1e788.png

Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f6dae038db2db4b0346441816487ba4084056ef6.jpg

You can enter Santa Orc's Getaway via Daredevil Faire.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/63fee8866fcba285041eed50098808000067d98d.png
Simply make Santa Orc fall by using skills or bombs that have been placed around the map. As he falls, there's a chance he may drop Santa Orc's Gift Pouch and other random debuff items.

Rewards
 
You can get one of the following items from [Santa Orc’s Gift Pouch]. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01d95cbcda0dac931d2cfdbccead64c5e0389e2a.jpg

Christmas Store
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d417f99e89eb2d4a06d0030a98b81598bada2504.png

You can spend the 2016 Christmas Exchange Coupon at NPC Cassie to buy the following items:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/08b3cd003cdc62155b49fd67960bf8d4719d4e42.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/13be43336637149802b42772677a24f078a41639.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2e6eced9d03ec65d758b0f4f1921bd0036da50ae.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04153abe2cf26f6dccd9e56d8c07bfd44068a3b0.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0b53b781b5a62a68e8d30d5cf8eed68e1238d2e1.png



5) Dragon Hunting Day
 
Hunt down Dragons every day, without worries of resurrection counts!
 
Simple click on the Dragon Hunting Icon at the bottom right of the screen during the designated hours (schedule below), and you will automatically be matched up with other Heroes.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/161d50aea10b0e8a1866bbb52d72f49c92044c3c.png
Notes:
- You cannot enter in a party.
- Dragon Hunting Day is played in "Compensation On" mode, which means your equipment does not matter in Dragon Hunting Day. All your stats are balanced (similar to Equalize in PVP).
- No reduction in durability
 
Schedule
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d54b7a1140c869d21d9d295d062667e0ec4c5603.png
*Above Timings are in PST



6) Others
 
A) Store Changes
 
Weapon Engraving Pouch has been added to the Goddess Aura Store.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c2dcbc3a2c6104e23a4e73ebdf17d9b8fa5b17fb.png
*It can be bought with 60 Goddess's Aura (2 per week), or with 40x Scroll Fragments and 5 gold (no limit)
 
 
Holy Shield skill heraldry has been removed. As such, it will no longer drop or sold at the Goddess's Sparkle Store.
 
 
B) Achievement Window
 
[Practice Mode] category has been added to the Nest tab of the achievement window.
You can find related achievements for existing and new practice mode nests there.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/961d3c7a40561d90175625c1c492df55990a85ec.png

C) Misc
 
Crafting Improvements
 
Skill Accessories equipped with Dragon Gem cannot be used as crafting materials anymore.
 
Changes in Equipment Repair Cost
 
Fixing cost for equipment will be reduced by 30% compared to the past. (All Rare grade Weapon/Armor, Epic grade Weapon/Armor below Lv80)

Changes in Hero’s Battlefield Rewards
 
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard): Special Skill Dragon Gem is removed, Goddess’s Lament x1, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x1 are added
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard Core): Goddess’s Lament x2, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x2 are added

Rock of Blessing
 
Rock of Blessing cannot be destroyed now.
Drop rate for Rock of Blessing is lowered. (Maximum quantity for each server remains the same)

Changes in Ice Dragon Stage 2 Skill
 
When Ice Dragon Stage 2 boss “Killing Machine Balapa” uses “Absorption” attack, all status effects on Balapa will be removed. (Applicable in all difficulty levels)

Changes in World Zone Resurrection Method
 
If you become a ghost in the World Zone, you can resurrect without using the Resurrection Scroll.
 
 
D) Balancing
[Work in Progress]

notes.title: Professor K Patch Notes 24th November
notes.notes:
1. Professor K Nest Remedial Class (Normal)
Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04e189ab6642f57cc3f75a4460387ee8fce88b03.png 

 
Rewards
 
You can get the followintg rewards upon completion of the nest:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e748be72d2cfe4659e92f968760c2ab6ccef3e4f.png
 
- Desirous / Ultimate Theano Equipments
- Armour Engraving Scroll
- Enhancement Crest Plate
- Epic Dragon Gems
- Hardened Drakonite
 
 
2. Ice Dragon Nest Practice Mode
 
Entry Info
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ffec07b28053abbf648136b526089b6222db04cb.png 

 
- Monsters in Practice Mode have 75% of attack power and HP of those in Normal Mode.
- With the addition of Practice Mode, the number of resurrections allowed in Ice Dragon Nest (Normal, 8-player nest) and Red Dragon Nest (Normal, 8-player nest) has been increased to 3 times.
 
Rewards
 
You can get the following Title from Ice Dragon Nest (Practice Mode)
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a5d20921860f270aa6b563a6db36ac390c2212cf.png

 
 
3. Reboot Daredevil Faire
 
Entry Info
 
Additional dungeons has been added to Daredevil Faire.
 
Reckless Umrak
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/95d2cfc5d7fde9476b83b01dd53f660f84cbccbf.png
 

 
Thorny Path
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/317c5bf05f64214e81d8299171a26c3e3f50668e.png

 
Hot-tempered Bacchus
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1fb751aaf5db48381ac3288e1e6381a6f024a5e7.png

 
To enter these dungeons, you need to speak to Magician Sanders and pick up a daily quest. Upon finishing the quest, you will be given some Entry Tickets.
Only characters level 70 and above can get Daily Quests from Magician Sanders.
 
 
 
4. Loffy's Dicey Dungeon
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c5376928781b278f0b75f927dababd46fa0010.png

 
Loffy's Dicey Dungeon is back and updated with Level 93 Rewards!
 
Entry Info
 
- Click on the Dice Icon to access the dungeon.
- You may enter the second time if you receive tickets from other players.
- Please note that Loffy's Dicey Dungeon will be closed every Saturday from 0730HRS to 0930HRS (PST)
 
Rewards
 
Below is a list of possible rewards from Loffy's Dicey Dungeon:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/236ad02e79844ff884ed4d447daf09d4968d3d93.jpg
 

 
 
 
 5. Ladder 1:1 Rank Battle ( Unavailable for now )
Due to a system issue, ladder will not be available and is expected to be fixed on 1st December's maintenance.
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b3366d4d5614b736b926be6989d0ee10d8c376bd.jpg
 
1:1 Rank Battle is an improved version of the previous Ladder, and rewards in the ladder shop has also been updated.
 
Will YOU be the one to hold the Diamond Tier rank?
 
Entry Info
 
You can participate in 1:1 Rank Battle the same way as Ladder.
 
Method 1: Matching UI
 
Click on the Matching Icon to open up the Matching UI
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b6d736bbbf9f3b8c26edc0ed1fda917e6b32d69d.jpg
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a9e959adef620bcda9c192a3ef67f7197315a7e1.png
 


 
Method 2: Colosseum UI
 
You may also enter via the colosseum window, then click on the 1:1 Rank tab.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5b7ba368c1faf457c774067a8ecace2884ba499c.png

 
Mechanics
 
- When you enter the 1:1 Rank map, you will see the Tier next to the character name as shown below.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/978e31f54cf4ccbc5a98817edfe43cf313d7b609.png

 
- Battle will be held for 5 minutes, during which you have to try to kill your opponent.
- Should both combatants remain standing after 5 minutes, the winner will be decided by the one with the higher remaining HP ratio.
- Winner will score points, EXP, and ladder points. Loser will get their ratings deducted and will not earn any ladder points
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4debb54a0d74252a6fc4f96aab2b22c006670077.jpg
 
- During the battle, you are not allowed to change equipment.
- If you leave the battle while it is still ongoing, you will be barred from entering another ladder match for 15 minutes.
 
 
Ranks
 
There are 16 rank tiers in total (including Unranked)
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4285bc43210c0d371a51de5d4049c1564f9b5334.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b866f30021f0e20af30dfb7f13dffe9580a16a22.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1e459243f54664e51d97c48b73d967b518c56431.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2c86e64fff2bf7a2540ec8927874b0363cce60ff.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/99021c1ab523335823fc47eaca8e0967ecf8aadc.jpg



 
- The Tier you have achieved will be maintained in the current regular season and pre-season.
- When the ranking is refreshed every morning while the season is ongoing, your Tier can rise or drop.
 
You may also choose to show your ranking via the options menu:
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1ab18a7028941e9d2e30bc8871cf5965c928d187.jpg

 
- The Tier you have achieved can be shown by selecting it in the Game Options.
- You can either show your Colosseum rank or Rank Tier.
- Not only you, but all characters will see the Rank Tier if you set it to be visible.
 
 
Ladder Points
 
When you win Ladder matches, you gain ladder points. However, there is a daily limit to the amount of points you can earn.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bbca63e3ec67667ee73fe0cefe4384d5fa23311d.jpg

 
 
Score Penalty
 
 
- Score penalty will occur when you don’t play 1:1 Rank Battle for a long time. (To prevent players from not playing after achieving a high score)
- If there are no records of playing within the penalty period, your score will be deducted according to the penalty value.
- Play record will be checked every morning and corresponding amount of penalty will be deducted.
- Ranking will be refreshed after penalty is given.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/aa34437e3fa157e8abdd1c4c6b249850b4ebebf4.jpg

 
 
 
6. Others
 
A. Engraving System
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/64798dd83066a1b0fdabb0ff60a1ef695a6cfa84.jpg

 
The Engraving System allows you to use Engraving Scrolls to enhance the stats of cash equipments.
 
[Armour Engraving Scroll] can be used on [Helmet] [Top] [Bottom] [Gloves] [Shoes] cash items which are Rare Grade or higher.
[Overall Engraving Scroll] can be used on [Overall] cash items which are Rare Grade or higher.
 
*Engraving scrolls for Weapons and Accessories will be released in the future
 
Items that has Engraving will be indicated by a "+" icon:
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03b357bd48b99dff9f602d3555bab5fa27934d10.jpg

 
Important note
 
- Only 1 Engraving is allowed for each item. New Engravings will overwrite the previous engraving effect.
- When items with Engraving are traded, the Engraving effect will follow as well.
- Engraving can be done on durational items as well. (However, Engraving effect will disappear when the item expires.)
 
 
B. +10 level 93 Dragon Gem
 
Level 93 Dragon Gems can now be enhanced to +10.
 
Enhancement attempts level of +8 ~ +10 will require Hardened Drakonite (Obtainable from Professor K Nest)
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96dd8ee25685d5d466d8c6144ceeffd5b60d9d20.jpg

 
 
C. Dragon Gem Disassembly
 
The amount of Dragon Gem fragments dropped by Disassembling Dragon Gems will now scale with the enhancement level of the disassembled Dragon Gem.
 
When a +15 Dragon Gem is disassembled, you can get a Fusion Cube.
 
 
D. Equipped Dragon Gem Tooltip Info
 
The Type and Enhancement level of Dragon Gems slotted in equipments are now reflected in the tooltip.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/125e83539c7c3716840f38b9fd59bceeb5bb47c7.jpg

 
 
E. Goddess's Aura Store
 
Engraving Scroll Pouch has been added to the Goddess's Aura Store.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3fdbf6ae5b368c4ec565040b261be78e97140c65.jpg

 
*Scroll Fragments can be obtained by disassembling Engraving Scrolls.
 
 
F. Ice Dragon Reward Changes
 
8-player Ice Dragon Nest (normal)'s rewards have been enhanced.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c84afe3807394bf5be95f8e6cbea780ed17d70bd.jpg

 
G. Balancing
 
Ladder:
 
All classes’ equipment stats ratio will be changed.
 
- Attack power ratio will be reduced.
- Defence power ratio will be increased.
- Max HP ratio will be increased.
 
 
Warden:
 
Cannonade (PVE, PVP)
- Hit area is shown immediately when the skill begins and hit area can be changed by changing the mouse direction (up or down).
- Cannon speed is increased.
 
Cyclone Harpoon (PVE, PVP)
-Number of hits is doubled.
 
Ward of the Spirits (PVE, PVP)
- Final damage is raised.
•PVE : 35% PVP: 27%
- The increase in final damage due to Skill Heraldry is now less.
* Magic : 1.25% Rare : 2.5% Epic : 5%
 
 
Sniper:
 
Siege Stance (PVE, PVP)
- Siege Stance’s normal hit is changed to be penetrating.
 
Wind Shaft (PVE, PVP)
- Hit area is increased for the first arrow.
 
H. Others
 
■ Title changes
- When [Cover Title] check box is not selected, title name will not be shown next to the character name.
- Even when the title is invisible, the stats will be applied if [Ability Title] check box is selected.
 
■ Legend Ice Dragon’s Fury
- Can now be stored in the server storage.


■ Ice Dragon Legend Equipment
- Can now be stored in the server storage.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/95d2cfc5d7fde9476b83b01dd53f660f84cbccbf.png
 

 
Thorny Path
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/317c5bf05f64214e81d8299171a26c3e3f50668e.png

 
Hot-tempered Bacchus
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1fb751aaf5db48381ac3288e1e6381a6f024a5e7.png

 
To enter these dungeons, you need to speak to Magician Sanders and pick up a daily quest. Upon finishing the quest, you will be given some Entry Tickets.
Only characters level 70 and above can get Daily Quests from Magician Sanders.
 
 
 
4. Loffy's Dicey Dungeon
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c5376928781b278f0b75f927dababd46fa0010.png

 
Loffy's Dicey Dungeon is back and updated with Level 93 Rewards!
 
Entry Info
 
- Click on the Dice Icon to access the dungeon.
- You may enter the second time if you receive tickets from other players.
- Please note that Loffy's Dicey Dungeon will be closed every Saturday from 0730HRS to 0930HRS (PST)
 
Rewards
 
Below is a list of possible rewards from Loffy's Dicey Dungeon:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/236ad02e79844ff884ed4d447daf09d4968d3d93.jpg
 

 
 
 
 5. Ladder 1:1 Rank Battle ( Unavailable for now )
Due to a system issue, ladder will not be available and is expected to be fixed on 1st December's maintenance.
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b3366d4d5614b736b926be6989d0ee10d8c376bd.jpg
 
1:1 Rank Battle is an improved version of the previous Ladder, and rewards in the ladder shop has also been updated.
 
Will YOU be the one to hold the Diamond Tier rank?
 
Entry Info
 
You can participate in 1:1 Rank Battle the same way as Ladder.
 
Method 1: Matching UI
 
Click on the Matching Icon to open up the Matching UI
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b6d736bbbf9f3b8c26edc0ed1fda917e6b32d69d.jpg
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a9e959adef620bcda9c192a3ef67f7197315a7e1.png
 


 
Method 2: Colosseum UI
 
You may also enter via the colosseum window, then click on the 1:1 Rank tab.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5b7ba368c1faf457c774067a8ecace2884ba499c.png

 
Mechanics
 
- When you enter the 1:1 Rank map, you will see the Tier next to the character name as shown below.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/978e31f54cf4ccbc5a98817edfe43cf313d7b609.png

 
- Battle will be held for 5 minutes, during which you have to try to kill your opponent.
- Should both combatants remain standing after 5 minutes, the winner will be decided by the one with the higher remaining HP ratio.
- Winner will score points, EXP, and ladder points. Loser will get their ratings deducted and will not earn any ladder points
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4debb54a0d74252a6fc4f96aab2b22c006670077.jpg
 
- During the battle, you are not allowed to change equipment.
- If you leave the battle while it is still ongoing, you will be barred from entering another ladder match for 15 minutes.
 
 
Ranks
 
There are 16 rank tiers in total (including Unranked)
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4285bc43210c0d371a51de5d4049c1564f9b5334.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b866f30021f0e20af30dfb7f13dffe9580a16a22.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1e459243f54664e51d97c48b73d967b518c56431.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2c86e64fff2bf7a2540ec8927874b0363cce60ff.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/99021c1ab523335823fc47eaca8e0967ecf8aadc.jpg



 
- The Tier you have achieved will be maintained in the current regular season and pre-season.
- When the ranking is refreshed every morning while the season is ongoing, your Tier can rise or drop.
 
You may also choose to show your ranking via the options menu:
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1ab18a7028941e9d2e30bc8871cf5965c928d187.jpg

 
- The Tier you have achieved can be shown by selecting it in the Game Options.
- You can either show your Colosseum rank or Rank Tier.
- Not only you, but all characters will see the Rank Tier if you set it to be visible.
 
 
Ladder Points
 
When you win Ladder matches, you gain ladder points. However, there is a daily limit to the amount of points you can earn.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bbca63e3ec67667ee73fe0cefe4384d5fa23311d.jpg

 
 
Score Penalty
 
 
- Score penalty will occur when you don’t play 1:1 Rank Battle for a long time. (To prevent players from not playing after achieving a high score)
- If there are no records of playing within the penalty period, your score will be deducted according to the penalty value.
- Play record will be checked every morning and corresponding amount of penalty will be deducted.
- Ranking will be refreshed after penalty is given.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/aa34437e3fa157e8abdd1c4c6b249850b4ebebf4.jpg

 
 
 
6. Others
 
A. Engraving System
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/64798dd83066a1b0fdabb0ff60a1ef695a6cfa84.jpg

 
The Engraving System allows you to use Engraving Scrolls to enhance the stats of cash equipments.
 
[Armour Engraving Scroll] can be used on [Helmet] [Top] [Bottom] [Gloves] [Shoes] cash items which are Rare Grade or higher.
[Overall Engraving Scroll] can be used on [Overall] cash items which are Rare Grade or higher.
 
*Engraving scrolls for Weapons and Accessories will be released in the future
 
Items that has Engraving will be indicated by a "+" icon:
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03b357bd48b99dff9f602d3555bab5fa27934d10.jpg

 
Important note
 
- Only 1 Engraving is allowed for each item. New Engravings will overwrite the previous engraving effect.
- When items with Engraving are traded, the Engraving effect will follow as well.
- Engraving can be done on durational items as well. (However, Engraving effect will disappear when the item expires.)
 
 
B. +10 level 93 Dragon Gem
 
Level 93 Dragon Gems can now be enhanced to +10.
 
Enhancement attempts level of +8 ~ +10 will require Hardened Drakonite (Obtainable from Professor K Nest)
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96dd8ee25685d5d466d8c6144ceeffd5b60d9d20.jpg

 
 
C. Dragon Gem Disassembly
 
The amount of Dragon Gem fragments dropped by Disassembling Dragon Gems will now scale with the enhancement level of the disassembled Dragon Gem.
 
When a +15 Dragon Gem is disassembled, you can get a Fusion Cube.
 
 
D. Equipped Dragon Gem Tooltip Info
 
The Type and Enhancement level of Dragon Gems slotted in equipments are now reflected in the tooltip.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/125e83539c7c3716840f38b9fd59bceeb5bb47c7.jpg

 
 
E. Goddess's Aura Store
 
Engraving Scroll Pouch has been added to the Goddess's Aura Store.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3fdbf6ae5b368c4ec565040b261be78e97140c65.jpg

 
*Scroll Fragments can be obtained by disassembling Engraving Scrolls.
 
 
F. Ice Dragon Reward Changes
 
8-player Ice Dragon Nest (normal)'s rewards have been enhanced.
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c84afe3807394bf5be95f8e6cbea780ed17d70bd.jpg

 
G. Balancing
 
Ladder:
 
All classes’ equipment stats ratio will be changed.
 
- Attack power ratio will be reduced.
- Defence power ratio will be increased.
- Max HP ratio will be increased.
 
 
Warden:
 
Cannonade (PVE, PVP)
- Hit area is shown immediately when the skill begins and hit area can be changed by changing the mouse direction (up or down).
- Cannon speed is increased.
 
Cyclone Harpoon (PVE, PVP)
-Number of hits is doubled.
 
Ward of the Spirits (PVE, PVP)
- Final damage is raised.
•PVE : 35% PVP: 27%
- The increase in final damage due to Skill Heraldry is now less.
* Magic : 1.25% Rare : 2.5% Epic : 5%
 
 
Sniper:
 
Siege Stance (PVE, PVP)
- Siege Stance’s normal hit is changed to be penetrating.
 
Wind Shaft (PVE, PVP)
- Hit area is increased for the first arrow.
 
H. Others
 
■ Title changes
- When [Cover Title] check box is not selected, title name will not be shown next to the character name.
- Even when the title is invisible, the stats will be applied if [Ability Title] check box is selected.
 
■ Legend Ice Dragon’s Fury
- Can now be stored in the server storage.


■ Ice Dragon Legend Equipment
- Can now be stored in the server storage.

Read all about the latest update arriving on May 12. Venture deep into the Nightmare Nest and make your way to the 4th Floor to meet its new bosses! The Dragon Vault will also be updated with new goodies.

New Content 
- Updated Nightmare Nest 
- Dragon Vault Update

Additional Updates 
- Bug Fixes

Updated Nightmare Nest
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6aa0d982-0010-428f-b264-c0835762d2ba.jpg

The might of the Monolith has succeeded in adding an additional floor to the Nightmare Nest! Grab your friends and journey deep inside until you find the new 4th Floor. Several bosses wait for you there, including the final boss, the Nightmare Watchman, who performs spin and rush attacks and throws a powerful fireball!

To enter the nightmare, click here.

Dragon Vault Update

- Various texts have been updated. 
- The Skill-Up Crest Pouch item now functions correctly. 
- The Tinkerer’s skill ‘Class Mastery II’ now functions as intended. 
- Little Winnie's Argenta costume now displays correctly.
