notes.title: Complete Patch Notes – Welcome the Silver Hunter
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-298ddbac-a2f6-4090-bcf0-cbd8ded4180f.jpg

Read all about the latest update arriving on April 14. Create the new Silver Hunter character class, and subdue your enemies with traps and the aid of your Falcon! Try out the updated Scorching Desert Dragon Nests, and explore new guild options. There are also new goodies in the Dragon Vault, some new events, skill updates, and more!

New Content 
- New Hero: Silver Hunter 
- Scorching Desert Dragon Nest 
- Dragon Vault Update 
- Guild Update

New Events 
- Armor Attendance Event 
- GM GlassRobot Heart Event

Skill Updates 
- Warrior Class Skill Changes 
- Archer Class Skill Changes 
- Sorceress Class Skill Changes 
- Cleric Class Skill Changes 
- Kali Class Skill Changes 
- Assassin Class Skill Changes 
- Machina Class Skill Changes

Additional Updates 
- Bug Fixes 
- UI Changes 
- Dungeon and Nest Changes 
- NPC Changes

New Hero: Silver Hunter
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-06c1052e-b877-4d93-a51b-db27038fabb5.jpg

Welcome the next Hero class to arrive in Altera, the Silver Hunter! A variant of the Archer class, the Silver Hunter sets traps to subdue her enemies, and is aided by a summoned Falcon which has its own attack skills. Character creation will only be available until June’s game update, tentatively scheduled for June 15, so create this highly nimble acrobatic class today!

To see the arrival of the Silver Hunter, click here.

Scorching Desert Dragon Nest

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-72f647c0-3078-4974-adc0-4184289f3edf.jpg

The ebb and flow of the Monolith has caused much frustration in the world of Altera. Those who have suffered have travelled to the outskirts of a barren desert, where their voices have gathered enough power to reopen the Desert Dragon Nest in its new form—the Scorching Desert Dragon Nest!

This nest is now ready for the Level 90 cap, and has been scaled to handle 4 players. The bosses have been reduced from 7 to 5, and the remaining bosses have been updated with new skills and tactics! The rewards have been updated as well:

- Abyss Rewards: Lv. 90 unique-grade Armor and Weapons, unique-grade Crests, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Coma, Brilliant Talisman Essence, Quality Life-giving Essence, Spaera 
- Hardcore Rewards: Lv. 90 unique-grade Armor and Weapons, unique-grade Crests, Brilliant Talisman Essence, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Coma, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Nightmare, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Cornura.

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-893dfd62-dfc4-4f1b-bd5b-0604164139db.jpg

Gerrant’s influence over the Dragon Eggs continues, with the last egg of the set, the Noble Gold Dragon Egg! Get your wing, tail, and decal and transform into Gerrant himself!

Join the flight crew of an airship with the new rare-grade costumes available in the Dragon Vault! The Silver Hunter has a special costume available as well. Machina gets some new hair and face styles, and your Little Winnie ally is ready for school! New items are also available in the Dragon Egg.

Guild Update

Enjoy new guild contents with your friends as we introduce the Sealed Guild Stone Tablet! Guild members can use Guild Points to activate this new feature.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-d3417482-aa42-4cd4-9fee-2e329d28f1f3.jpg

Once activated, guild members ranked officer level and above can give Guild Points to the Sealed Guild Stone Tablet to fill up its meter. Once a day, general guild members can also add points by using “Hasten” which gives extra points to the meter. “Hasten” resets at 9:00 AM Pacific each day. Once the meter reaches 100%, all members of the guild will receive rewards based on their rank!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-f0990ea4-c695-40ae-bed8-3947adeaa8fe.JPG

Armor Attendance Event
Thursday, April 14 – Thursday, May 12

Log in to Dragon Nest during the Armor Attendance Event, and receive daily rewards. You can also earn yourself some nice gear! This event can be repeated on each character, so that all of your characters get geared up!

- Log in 1 day, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 2 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 3 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 4 days, and receive one Goddess Wellspring. 
- Log in 5 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 6 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 7 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 8 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 9 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 10 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 11 days, and receive one Goddess Wellspring. 
- Log in 12 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 13 days, and receive one Pet Alicorn (7 days). 
- Log in 14 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 15 days, and receive four Talisman Pouches (Attribute) (7 days). 
- Log in 16 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 17 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 18 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 19 days, and receive Lv. 90 Epic-Grade Coma Shoes. 
- Log in 20 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 21 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 22 days, and receive one Pet Alicorn (7 days). 
- Log in 23 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 24 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 25 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 26 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 27 days, and receive Lv. 90 Epic-Grade Coma Headgear. 
- Log in 28 days, and receive Lv. 90 Epic-Grade Coma Body Armor. 
- Log in 29 days, and receive one Dragon Egg.

Each item will be sent to your character’s in-game mailbox when you log in on the appointed day. Make sure to log in with one of your characters every day so that your character gets rewarded!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-af127ddd-5375-443f-a501-28d09a262908.jpg

GM GlassRobot Heart Event
Thursday, April 14 – Thursday, May 12

Log in to Dragon Nest to receive GM Hearts! Each day during the event period, stay logged in for 5 minutes to receive a GM Heart. Continue to stay logged in for 10 minutes to receive another GM Heart. At the 15-minute and 20-minute marks, you will receive another GM Heart for a total of four GM Hearts per day. The hearts will be automatically added to your inventory in the NX -> Costume tab. You can repeat this event on each character.

Hang onto those hearts and take them to NPC Cassie, located at the fountain in Saint’s Haven. She will happily take them off your hands in exchange for some special costumes!

- 9 GM Hearts - Moonlight Tail 
- 10 GM Hearts - Moonlight Earrings 
- 16 GM Hearts - Moonlight Ring 
- 20 GM Hearts - Moonlight Wings 
- 25 GM Hearts - Moonlight Cap

All items but the Moonlight Cap contribute towards the First Half 2016 Set Bonus. These items are untradeable. There is no limit to the amount of reward items you can receive.

Set Bonuses 
- Equip two pieces to increase Critical. 
- Equip four pieces to increase Strength, Agility, Intellect, and Vitality. 
- Equip five pieces to increase Physical/Magic Damage. 
- Equip seven pieces to increase Max HP/MP. 
- Equip eight pieces to further increase Physical/Magic Damage and Final Damage.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-1a2b7177-a002-466d-b1de-7511efcb5d1f.jpg

Warrior Class Skill Changes

Warrior 
- Dash Kick: Reduces cooldown of skill by 1 second on every point increase after obtaining skill (PVE).

Swordsman 
- Triple Slash: Cooldown has been changed to 12 seconds (PVP). 
- Forward Thrust: Cooldown has been changed to 13 seconds (PVP). 
- Luring Strike: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 217% to 920% (PVE). 
- Eclipse: Reduces cooldown of skill by 1 second on every point increase after obtaining skill (PVE). 
- Frenzied Charge: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,139% to 3,159% (PVE). Inverse Paralyze has been removed (PVE/PVP).

Gladiator 
- Feint: If Feint successfully lands, the skill removes the active cooldown on Forward Thrust and Triple Sash (PVE). 
- Class Mastery: Hype Train has maximum count of 20 (PVE/PVP). Has increased duration of 60 seconds (PVE/PVP). Strength increase for each point is now 4% (PVE). The main skill cooldowns have been changed per point – PVE: 0.3 seconds; PVP: 2 seconds (PVE/PVP). The affected skills are Triple Sash, Forward Thrust, Hacking Stance, Frenzied Charge, and Feint. Cooldown has been changed to 1 second (PVP). Cooldown Recovery Amount has been changed to 20% (PVP). 
- Frenzied Charge EX: Damage per each blade has been changed to 10% (PVE/PVP). Dash distance is reduced if used while moving backwards and can activate [Dash Kick] by inputting the [Special Attack Button] (PVE/ PVP). 
- Coup de Grace: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,788% to 3,476% (PVE). Additional damage amount has been increased. Max Level Damage – 8% to 16% (PVE).

Archer Class Skill Changes

Acrobat 
- Marionette: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 780% to 1,425% (PVE). 
- Blooming Kick: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 950% to 2,396% (PVE). 
- Spiral Kick: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 581% to 1,182% (PVE). 
- Kick Shot: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 948% to 1,881% (PVE). 
- Furious Winds: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,731% to 4,258% (PVE). 
- Cyclone Kick: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,948% to 3,491% (PVE). 
- Eagle Dive: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 760% to 1,403% (PVE). 
- Somersault Dance: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 514% to 2,004% (PVE).

Tempest 
- Hurricane Dance: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,031% to 2,194% (PVE).

Windwalker 
- Rising Storm: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,705% to 3,711% (PVE).

Hunter 
- Monkey Roll: Level 1 cooldown has been changed to 7 seconds (PVE).

Silver Hunter 
- Summon Falcon: Invincibility during summon has been removed (PVP). 
- Silver Hunter: Using Tumble after transformation now costs 7 Vigor (PVE/PVP).

Sorceress Class Skill Changes

Elementalist 
- Frozen Fury: Invincibility has been added while skill is being used (PVE). 
- Inferno: Cooldown has been changed to 16 seconds (PVE). 
- Fire Wall: Cooldown has been changed to 16 seconds (PVE). 
- Hot Rod: Cooldown has been changed to 25 seconds (PVE).

Ice Witch 
- Frost Chaos: Cooldown has been changed to 25 seconds (PVP). 
- Ice Barrier: Freeze effect has been removed when the barrier is lost (PVE/PVP). Duration has been changed to 60 seconds and the cooldown has been changed to 120 seconds (PVE/PVP). 
- Class Mastery: Ice Barrier cooldown is reduced by 1 second for every Ice elemental attack that successfully hits. (PVE/PVP). 
- Ice Barrier EX: Barrier removal can no longer be manually triggered (PVE/PVP). Cooldown recovery speed increase by 30% for the following skills; Icy Shards, Ice Cold Field, Frozen Spikes, Chilling Mist, Blizzard, Frost Chaos (PVE/PVP). Ice Magic Attack increase will be maintained while Ice Barrier is active. (PVE/PVP). Ice Magic increases by 30% (PVE/PVP).

Pyromancer 
- Burning Hand: Additional damage done to target with burns has been decreased by 50% (PVE).

Cleric Class Skill Changes

Priest 
- Grand Cross: Adjusted skill damage per hit and fixed correlating bug/issue. (PVE/PVP)

Paladin 
- Divine Hammer: Invincibility has been added while skill is being used (PVE).

Crusader 
- Judgmental Hammer: Additional damage increase based on distance will be removed (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 202%/229% to 2,377%/2,979% (PVE).

Kali Class Skill Changes

Dancer 
- Dance of Ecstasy: The Orc Spirit and Ghoul Spirit are now summoned together. The Jump key can now be used for summoning. 
- Chakram Flurry: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,901% to 4,301% (PVE). 
- Whirligig: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,643% to 2,414% (PVE). 
- Bladeflip: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,236% to 1,805% (PVE). 
- Swivel Charge: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,544% to 3,766% (PVE). 
- Chakram Storm: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 4,555% to 6,782% (PVE). 
- Frolic: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 5,659% to 8,438% (PVE). 
- Stalker: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 768% to 2,104% (PVE). 
- Dusk Hunter: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,526% to 3,308% (PVE). 
- Abolisher: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 915% to 3,767% (PVE). 
- Whirling Dervishes: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 740% to 1,074% (PVE). 
- General Dawnblade: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,955% to 6,524% (PVE). 
- Typhoon Ewiniar: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 8,866% to 13,249% (PVE).

Blade Dancer 
- Squall Spin: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,312% to 1,944% (PVE). 
- Gust Dementia: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 4,133% has been changed to Damage per Hit of 402% 
- Bladeflip EX: Gust Dementia can now be activated when pressing the regular attack button (PVE/PVP). 
- Gust Dementia EX: The hit count has been removed and damage has been increased (PVE/PVP); PVE – 50%, PVP – 25%.

Spirit Dancer 
- Sting: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,972% to 4,311%. 
- Praetor: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 3,300% to 6,340%

Assassin Class Skill Changes

Assassin 
- Triple Blade: Cooldown has been changed to 12 seconds (PVE/PVP).

Shinobi 
- Open Edge: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,098% to 1,597% (PVE). 
- Iron Applause: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage –1,151% to 2,433% (PVE). 
- Raking Stars: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 180% to 259% (PVE). 
- Rain of Death: Cooldown has been changed to 6 seconds (PVE). 
- Chain Punisher: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,412% to 4,069% (PVE). 
- Overkill: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 237% to 578% (PVE). 
- Barrage: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been decreased. Max Level Damage – 1,665% to 1,527% (PVE). 
- Flame Locust: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,187% to 2,017% (PVE). 
- Blade Runner: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,516% to 1,940% (PVE). 
- Mortal Blow: Cooldown has been changed to 12 seconds (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,306% to 3,115% (PVE). 
- Shinobi Drop: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,084% to 3,642% (PVE). 
- Burning Escape: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Reduces cooldown of skill by 1 second on every point increase after obtaining skill (PVE).Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 394% to 2,000% (PVE). 
- Chain Chaser: Level 1 skill cooldown has been changed to 15 seconds (PVE). 
- Fade: Damage increase and damage received increase has been removed (PVE/PVP). Duration has been changed to 10 seconds (PVE/PVP). 
- Dedicate Shadow: Now recovers HP every 2 seconds (PVE/PVP). Small MP Consumption has been added (PVE/PVP). 
- Illusion Step: Cooldown has been changed to 7 seconds (PVE). Cooldown of 20 seconds still remains in PVP.

Raven 
- Umbra: Cooldown has been changed to 15 seconds (PVE). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,528% to 2,956% (PVE). 
- Dead Fall: Cooldown has been changed to 15 seconds (PVE). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,581% to 4,671% (PVE). 
- Class Mastery: Reduces Triple Blade cooldown by 50% (PVE/PVP). Final Damage increases by 10% for 30 seconds when using the Fade skill (PVE). Dark Magic damage has been increased to 30%. 
- Class Mastery II: The Raking Stars EX skill shared cooldown has been removed (PVE/PVP). Damage value has been increased to 20% (PVE). 
- Open Edge EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 6 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Raking Stars EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 12 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Chain Punisher EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 20 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Umbra EX: Pulls enemies when Poison Cloud appears (PVE/PVP). Explosion damage has been increased to 200%.

Reaper 
- Arsonist: Cooldown has been changed to 10 seconds and duration has been increased to 60 seconds (PVE). 
- Pursuer: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 4,044% to 4,478% (PVE). 
- Class Mastery: Dedicate Shadow effect has been removed. Burning Escape gains a 50% to cooldown when skill is obtained. Fire damage value has been increased to 20% (PVE). 
- Class Mastery II: Damage value has been increased to 30% (PVE). 
- Flame Locust EX: Additional Hit Explosion damage has been increased (PVE). 
- Blade Runner EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 8 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Shinobi Drop EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 16 seconds when obtained (PVE). Invincibility has been added while the skill is active (PVE).

Machina Class Skill Changes

Machina 
- Fly-by: Retro Charge can be linked when enemy is hit with the Fly-by skill (PVE/PVP).

Patrona 
- Follow Up: Damage has been changed from per Hit to All Damage (PVE/PVP). Damage has been decreased. Max Level Damage per hit 656% to Total Damage 1,212% (PVE). 
- Exploding Palm: Range of Wave has been decreased (PVE/PVP). Wave hit count has been increased by 1 (PVE/PVP). 
- Kidney Blow: Cooldown has been changed to 23 seconds (PVE). 
- Beat Down: Cooldown has been changed to 14 seconds (PVE) and 18 seconds (PVP). Charging Gear link has been improved (PVE/PVP). 
- Twister Kick: Cooldown has been changed to 24 seconds (PVE) and 29 seconds (PVP). Charging Gear link has been improved (PVE/PVP). Damage has been changed from per Hit to All Damage (PVE/PVP). 
- Overclock: Steam Recovery amount has been increased (PVE).

Ruina 
- Exploding Palm EX: Range of Wave has been decreased. Wave Time has been shortened. Wave Super Armor has been decreased (PVE/PVP). 
- Pressure Burst: Damage has been decreased. Max Level Damage – 4,113% to 3,622% (PVE). 
- Pressure Burst EX: Additional hits are now possible even when skill fails to hit enemies on initial attack.

Defensio 
- Beat Down EX: Additional Hit damage has been increased (PVE). 
- Twister Kick EX: Additional Hit damage has been increased (PVE). 
- Class Mastery II: Can be immediately activated following a Beat Down Instant skill activation (PVE/PVE).

Bug Fixes

- Various texts have been updated. 
- Completing Arendel dungeons no longer crashes the client. 
- Dragon Gem Enhancement UI issue has been fixed. 

UI Changes

- Login screen has been updated to the Silver Hunter. 
- “Daily Achievements” have been removed from the Achievements window and have been placed in a new window called “Mission List”. It can be found by clicking on the Parchment Icon in the lower right or by opening the Event window. Achievement points have been adjusted because of this change. 
- “Exit Game” now has an Irine UI that will confirm the player’s exit from the game. If an Attendance Event is active, your next Attendance reward is displayed. 
- The Mercenary Collection window has been updated. All mercenaries yet to be obtained now have inactive icons present. Mercenaries can also be unequipped from the window. 
- “Increase Max View” distance option has been added to the System Settings menu. 
- A side-by-side comparison window has been added for equipment hover displays.

Dungeon and Nest Changes

- The Rank Rewards screen has been revamped, and no longer gives a grade. Max Combo, Kill Count, Party Number, Rank have been removed and no longer affect end rank. The grade has been replaced with the three stars. The color of the star determines your rank in the dungeon. The only stat that counts toward the end rank is number of deaths in the dungeon/nest. Quests that require “C Rank or Higher” have been changed to just “Clear”. Remote Quests that require “S Rank or Higher” have been changed to just “Clear”. An 8-player reward screen has been added to 8-player nests. 
- The UI for the end of a dungeon has been updated with new icons. The functionality has not changed. 
- Daidalos Nest (Hardcore) may reward players with Quality Life-giving Essence. The Revive Count has been increased to 5. 
- Twisted Territory daily quests have been removed. 
- Epic Element Attribute titles have been added to the Aorta Gate and Azure Road Abyss difficulty dungeons.

NPC Changes

- NPC Blacksmiths can now officially enhance Lv. 90 Dragon Gems to +14. The message for a successful Dragon Gem Enhancement has been removed. 
- NPC Blacksmiths can now craft the following items: Lv. 90 Evolution Weapons, Hammers of Evolution, Legendary Ring, Quality Life-Giving Essence, and Lv. 90 Rare Grade Talismans. 
- Goddess’s Lament Shops have been updated with the following items: Goddess’s Despair (Pouch), Goddess Title: Vessel of the Goddess, Goddess Title: The Dejected, and Light Cube. 
- Goddess Aura Shop has been updated with the following items: Quality Life-giving Essence, Hammer of Evolution Shard – Coma, and Light Cube. Prophet Gears have replaced the Felis Gears. 
- Nightmare Star Shop has been updated with the following items: Drakonite, Quality Drakonite, and Superb Drakonite. 
- Dragon Scale Shop has been updated with new Legendary Grade Element Conversion Gems. 
- Dragon Scale Crafting has been removed.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-72f647c0-3078-4974-adc0-4184289f3edf.jpg

The ebb and flow of the Monolith has caused much frustration in the world of Altera. Those who have suffered have travelled to the outskirts of a barren desert, where their voices have gathered enough power to reopen the Desert Dragon Nest in its new form—the Scorching Desert Dragon Nest!

This nest is now ready for the Level 90 cap, and has been scaled to handle 4 players. The bosses have been reduced from 7 to 5, and the remaining bosses have been updated with new skills and tactics! The rewards have been updated as well:

- Abyss Rewards: Lv. 90 unique-grade Armor and Weapons, unique-grade Crests, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Coma, Brilliant Talisman Essence, Quality Life-giving Essence, Spaera 
- Hardcore Rewards: Lv. 90 unique-grade Armor and Weapons, unique-grade Crests, Brilliant Talisman Essence, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Coma, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Nightmare, Hammer of Evolution Shard - Cornura.

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-893dfd62-dfc4-4f1b-bd5b-0604164139db.jpg

Gerrant’s influence over the Dragon Eggs continues, with the last egg of the set, the Noble Gold Dragon Egg! Get your wing, tail, and decal and transform into Gerrant himself!

Join the flight crew of an airship with the new rare-grade costumes available in the Dragon Vault! The Silver Hunter has a special costume available as well. Machina gets some new hair and face styles, and your Little Winnie ally is ready for school! New items are also available in the Dragon Egg.

Guild Update

Enjoy new guild contents with your friends as we introduce the Sealed Guild Stone Tablet! Guild members can use Guild Points to activate this new feature.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-d3417482-aa42-4cd4-9fee-2e329d28f1f3.jpg

Once activated, guild members ranked officer level and above can give Guild Points to the Sealed Guild Stone Tablet to fill up its meter. Once a day, general guild members can also add points by using “Hasten” which gives extra points to the meter. “Hasten” resets at 9:00 AM Pacific each day. Once the meter reaches 100%, all members of the guild will receive rewards based on their rank!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-f0990ea4-c695-40ae-bed8-3947adeaa8fe.JPG

Armor Attendance Event
Thursday, April 14 – Thursday, May 12

Log in to Dragon Nest during the Armor Attendance Event, and receive daily rewards. You can also earn yourself some nice gear! This event can be repeated on each character, so that all of your characters get geared up!

- Log in 1 day, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 2 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 3 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 4 days, and receive one Goddess Wellspring. 
- Log in 5 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 6 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 7 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 8 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 9 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 10 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 11 days, and receive one Goddess Wellspring. 
- Log in 12 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 13 days, and receive one Pet Alicorn (7 days). 
- Log in 14 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 15 days, and receive four Talisman Pouches (Attribute) (7 days). 
- Log in 16 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 17 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 18 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 19 days, and receive Lv. 90 Epic-Grade Coma Shoes. 
- Log in 20 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 21 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 22 days, and receive one Pet Alicorn (7 days). 
- Log in 23 days, and receive one Dreamy Approval Stamp. 
- Log in 24 days, and receive one Dreamy Blue Courier Bird. 
- Log in 25 days, and receive one Dreamy Magnifying Glass. 
- Log in 26 days, and receive one Dreamy Item Protection Magic Jelly. 
- Log in 27 days, and receive Lv. 90 Epic-Grade Coma Headgear. 
- Log in 28 days, and receive Lv. 90 Epic-Grade Coma Body Armor. 
- Log in 29 days, and receive one Dragon Egg.

Each item will be sent to your character’s in-game mailbox when you log in on the appointed day. Make sure to log in with one of your characters every day so that your character gets rewarded!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-af127ddd-5375-443f-a501-28d09a262908.jpg

GM GlassRobot Heart Event
Thursday, April 14 – Thursday, May 12

Log in to Dragon Nest to receive GM Hearts! Each day during the event period, stay logged in for 5 minutes to receive a GM Heart. Continue to stay logged in for 10 minutes to receive another GM Heart. At the 15-minute and 20-minute marks, you will receive another GM Heart for a total of four GM Hearts per day. The hearts will be automatically added to your inventory in the NX -> Costume tab. You can repeat this event on each character.

Hang onto those hearts and take them to NPC Cassie, located at the fountain in Saint’s Haven. She will happily take them off your hands in exchange for some special costumes!

- 9 GM Hearts - Moonlight Tail 
- 10 GM Hearts - Moonlight Earrings 
- 16 GM Hearts - Moonlight Ring 
- 20 GM Hearts - Moonlight Wings 
- 25 GM Hearts - Moonlight Cap

All items but the Moonlight Cap contribute towards the First Half 2016 Set Bonus. These items are untradeable. There is no limit to the amount of reward items you can receive.

Set Bonuses 
- Equip two pieces to increase Critical. 
- Equip four pieces to increase Strength, Agility, Intellect, and Vitality. 
- Equip five pieces to increase Physical/Magic Damage. 
- Equip seven pieces to increase Max HP/MP. 
- Equip eight pieces to further increase Physical/Magic Damage and Final Damage.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-1a2b7177-a002-466d-b1de-7511efcb5d1f.jpg

Warrior Class Skill Changes

Warrior 
- Dash Kick: Reduces cooldown of skill by 1 second on every point increase after obtaining skill (PVE).

Swordsman 
- Triple Slash: Cooldown has been changed to 12 seconds (PVP). 
- Forward Thrust: Cooldown has been changed to 13 seconds (PVP). 
- Luring Strike: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 217% to 920% (PVE). 
- Eclipse: Reduces cooldown of skill by 1 second on every point increase after obtaining skill (PVE). 
- Frenzied Charge: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,139% to 3,159% (PVE). Inverse Paralyze has been removed (PVE/PVP).

Gladiator 
- Feint: If Feint successfully lands, the skill removes the active cooldown on Forward Thrust and Triple Sash (PVE). 
- Class Mastery: Hype Train has maximum count of 20 (PVE/PVP). Has increased duration of 60 seconds (PVE/PVP). Strength increase for each point is now 4% (PVE). The main skill cooldowns have been changed per point – PVE: 0.3 seconds; PVP: 2 seconds (PVE/PVP). The affected skills are Triple Sash, Forward Thrust, Hacking Stance, Frenzied Charge, and Feint. Cooldown has been changed to 1 second (PVP). Cooldown Recovery Amount has been changed to 20% (PVP). 
- Frenzied Charge EX: Damage per each blade has been changed to 10% (PVE/PVP). Dash distance is reduced if used while moving backwards and can activate [Dash Kick] by inputting the [Special Attack Button] (PVE/ PVP). 
- Coup de Grace: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,788% to 3,476% (PVE). Additional damage amount has been increased. Max Level Damage – 8% to 16% (PVE).

Archer Class Skill Changes

Acrobat 
- Marionette: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 780% to 1,425% (PVE). 
- Blooming Kick: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 950% to 2,396% (PVE). 
- Spiral Kick: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 581% to 1,182% (PVE). 
- Kick Shot: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 948% to 1,881% (PVE). 
- Furious Winds: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,731% to 4,258% (PVE). 
- Cyclone Kick: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,948% to 3,491% (PVE). 
- Eagle Dive: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 760% to 1,403% (PVE). 
- Somersault Dance: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 514% to 2,004% (PVE).

Tempest 
- Hurricane Dance: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,031% to 2,194% (PVE).

Windwalker 
- Rising Storm: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,705% to 3,711% (PVE).

Hunter 
- Monkey Roll: Level 1 cooldown has been changed to 7 seconds (PVE).

Silver Hunter 
- Summon Falcon: Invincibility during summon has been removed (PVP). 
- Silver Hunter: Using Tumble after transformation now costs 7 Vigor (PVE/PVP).

Sorceress Class Skill Changes

Elementalist 
- Frozen Fury: Invincibility has been added while skill is being used (PVE). 
- Inferno: Cooldown has been changed to 16 seconds (PVE). 
- Fire Wall: Cooldown has been changed to 16 seconds (PVE). 
- Hot Rod: Cooldown has been changed to 25 seconds (PVE).

Ice Witch 
- Frost Chaos: Cooldown has been changed to 25 seconds (PVP). 
- Ice Barrier: Freeze effect has been removed when the barrier is lost (PVE/PVP). Duration has been changed to 60 seconds and the cooldown has been changed to 120 seconds (PVE/PVP). 
- Class Mastery: Ice Barrier cooldown is reduced by 1 second for every Ice elemental attack that successfully hits. (PVE/PVP). 
- Ice Barrier EX: Barrier removal can no longer be manually triggered (PVE/PVP). Cooldown recovery speed increase by 30% for the following skills; Icy Shards, Ice Cold Field, Frozen Spikes, Chilling Mist, Blizzard, Frost Chaos (PVE/PVP). Ice Magic Attack increase will be maintained while Ice Barrier is active. (PVE/PVP). Ice Magic increases by 30% (PVE/PVP).

Pyromancer 
- Burning Hand: Additional damage done to target with burns has been decreased by 50% (PVE).

Cleric Class Skill Changes

Priest 
- Grand Cross: Adjusted skill damage per hit and fixed correlating bug/issue. (PVE/PVP)

Paladin 
- Divine Hammer: Invincibility has been added while skill is being used (PVE).

Crusader 
- Judgmental Hammer: Additional damage increase based on distance will be removed (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 202%/229% to 2,377%/2,979% (PVE).

Kali Class Skill Changes

Dancer 
- Dance of Ecstasy: The Orc Spirit and Ghoul Spirit are now summoned together. The Jump key can now be used for summoning. 
- Chakram Flurry: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,901% to 4,301% (PVE). 
- Whirligig: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,643% to 2,414% (PVE). 
- Bladeflip: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,236% to 1,805% (PVE). 
- Swivel Charge: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,544% to 3,766% (PVE). 
- Chakram Storm: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 4,555% to 6,782% (PVE). 
- Frolic: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 5,659% to 8,438% (PVE). 
- Stalker: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 768% to 2,104% (PVE). 
- Dusk Hunter: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,526% to 3,308% (PVE). 
- Abolisher: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 915% to 3,767% (PVE). 
- Whirling Dervishes: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 740% to 1,074% (PVE). 
- General Dawnblade: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 2,955% to 6,524% (PVE). 
- Typhoon Ewiniar: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 8,866% to 13,249% (PVE).

Blade Dancer 
- Squall Spin: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,312% to 1,944% (PVE). 
- Gust Dementia: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 4,133% has been changed to Damage per Hit of 402% 
- Bladeflip EX: Gust Dementia can now be activated when pressing the regular attack button (PVE/PVP). 
- Gust Dementia EX: The hit count has been removed and damage has been increased (PVE/PVP); PVE – 50%, PVP – 25%.

Spirit Dancer 
- Sting: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,972% to 4,311%. 
- Praetor: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 3,300% to 6,340%

Assassin Class Skill Changes

Assassin 
- Triple Blade: Cooldown has been changed to 12 seconds (PVE/PVP).

Shinobi 
- Open Edge: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,098% to 1,597% (PVE). 
- Iron Applause: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage –1,151% to 2,433% (PVE). 
- Raking Stars: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 180% to 259% (PVE). 
- Rain of Death: Cooldown has been changed to 6 seconds (PVE). 
- Chain Punisher: Now a Dark Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,412% to 4,069% (PVE). 
- Overkill: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 237% to 578% (PVE). 
- Barrage: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been decreased. Max Level Damage – 1,665% to 1,527% (PVE). 
- Flame Locust: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,187% to 2,017% (PVE). 
- Blade Runner: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,516% to 1,940% (PVE). 
- Mortal Blow: Cooldown has been changed to 12 seconds (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,306% to 3,115% (PVE). 
- Shinobi Drop: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,084% to 3,642% (PVE). 
- Burning Escape: Now a Fire Elemental Attack (PVE/PVP). Reduces cooldown of skill by 1 second on every point increase after obtaining skill (PVE).Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 394% to 2,000% (PVE). 
- Chain Chaser: Level 1 skill cooldown has been changed to 15 seconds (PVE). 
- Fade: Damage increase and damage received increase has been removed (PVE/PVP). Duration has been changed to 10 seconds (PVE/PVP). 
- Dedicate Shadow: Now recovers HP every 2 seconds (PVE/PVP). Small MP Consumption has been added (PVE/PVP). 
- Illusion Step: Cooldown has been changed to 7 seconds (PVE). Cooldown of 20 seconds still remains in PVP.

Raven 
- Umbra: Cooldown has been changed to 15 seconds (PVE). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,528% to 2,956% (PVE). 
- Dead Fall: Cooldown has been changed to 15 seconds (PVE). Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 1,581% to 4,671% (PVE). 
- Class Mastery: Reduces Triple Blade cooldown by 50% (PVE/PVP). Final Damage increases by 10% for 30 seconds when using the Fade skill (PVE). Dark Magic damage has been increased to 30%. 
- Class Mastery II: The Raking Stars EX skill shared cooldown has been removed (PVE/PVP). Damage value has been increased to 20% (PVE). 
- Open Edge EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 6 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Raking Stars EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 12 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Chain Punisher EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 20 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Umbra EX: Pulls enemies when Poison Cloud appears (PVE/PVP). Explosion damage has been increased to 200%.

Reaper 
- Arsonist: Cooldown has been changed to 10 seconds and duration has been increased to 60 seconds (PVE). 
- Pursuer: Damage has been increased. Max Level Damage – 4,044% to 4,478% (PVE). 
- Class Mastery: Dedicate Shadow effect has been removed. Burning Escape gains a 50% to cooldown when skill is obtained. Fire damage value has been increased to 20% (PVE). 
- Class Mastery II: Damage value has been increased to 30% (PVE). 
- Flame Locust EX: Additional Hit Explosion damage has been increased (PVE). 
- Blade Runner EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 8 seconds when obtained (PVE). 
- Shinobi Drop EX: Changes cooldown of skill to 16 seconds when obtained (PVE). Invincibility has been added while the skill is active (PVE).

Machina Class Skill Changes

Machina 
- Fly-by: Retro Charge can be linked when enemy is hit with the Fly-by skill (PVE/PVP).

Patrona 
- Follow Up: Damage has been changed from per Hit to All Damage (PVE/PVP). Damage has been decreased. Max Level Damage per hit 656% to Total Damage 1,212% (PVE). 
- Exploding Palm: Range of Wave has been decreased (PVE/PVP). Wave hit count has been increased by 1 (PVE/PVP). 
- Kidney Blow: Cooldown has been changed to 23 seconds (PVE). 
- Beat Down: Cooldown has been changed to 14 seconds (PVE) and 18 seconds (PVP). Charging Gear link has been improved (PVE/PVP). 
- Twister Kick: Cooldown has been changed to 24 seconds (PVE) and 29 seconds (PVP). Charging Gear link has been improved (PVE/PVP). Damage has been changed from per Hit to All Damage (PVE/PVP). 
- Overclock: Steam Recovery amount has been increased (PVE).

Ruina 
- Exploding Palm EX: Range of Wave has been decreased. Wave Time has been shortened. Wave Super Armor has been decreased (PVE/PVP). 
- Pressure Burst: Damage has been decreased. Max Level Damage – 4,113% to 3,622% (PVE). 
- Pressure Burst EX: Additional hits are now possible even when skill fails to hit enemies on initial attack.

Defensio 
- Beat Down EX: Additional Hit damage has been increased (PVE). 
- Twister Kick EX: Additional Hit damage has been increased (PVE). 
- Class Mastery II: Can be immediately activated following a Beat Down Instant skill activation (PVE/PVE).

Bug Fixes

- Various texts have been updated. 
- Completing Arendel dungeons no longer crashes the client. 
- Dragon Gem Enhancement UI issue has been fixed. 

UI Changes

- Login screen has been updated to the Silver Hunter. 
- “Daily Achievements” have been removed from the Achievements window and have been placed in a new window called “Mission List”. It can be found by clicking on the Parchment Icon in the lower right or by opening the Event window. Achievement points have been adjusted because of this change. 
- “Exit Game” now has an Irine UI that will confirm the player’s exit from the game. If an Attendance Event is active, your next Attendance reward is displayed. 
- The Mercenary Collection window has been updated. All mercenaries yet to be obtained now have inactive icons present. Mercenaries can also be unequipped from the window. 
- “Increase Max View” distance option has been added to the System Settings menu. 
- A side-by-side comparison window has been added for equipment hover displays.

Dungeon and Nest Changes

- The Rank Rewards screen has been revamped, and no longer gives a grade. Max Combo, Kill Count, Party Number, Rank have been removed and no longer affect end rank. The grade has been replaced with the three stars. The color of the star determines your rank in the dungeon. The only stat that counts toward the end rank is number of deaths in the dungeon/nest. Quests that require “C Rank or Higher” have been changed to just “Clear”. Remote Quests that require “S Rank or Higher” have been changed to just “Clear”. An 8-player reward screen has been added to 8-player nests. 
- The UI for the end of a dungeon has been updated with new icons. The functionality has not changed. 
- Daidalos Nest (Hardcore) may reward players with Quality Life-giving Essence. The Revive Count has been increased to 5. 
- Twisted Territory daily quests have been removed. 
- Epic Element Attribute titles have been added to the Aorta Gate and Azure Road Abyss difficulty dungeons.

NPC Changes

- NPC Blacksmiths can now officially enhance Lv. 90 Dragon Gems to +14. The message for a successful Dragon Gem Enhancement has been removed. 
- NPC Blacksmiths can now craft the following items: Lv. 90 Evolution Weapons, Hammers of Evolution, Legendary Ring, Quality Life-Giving Essence, and Lv. 90 Rare Grade Talismans. 
- Goddess’s Lament Shops have been updated with the following items: Goddess’s Despair (Pouch), Goddess Title: Vessel of the Goddess, Goddess Title: The Dejected, and Light Cube. 
- Goddess Aura Shop has been updated with the following items: Quality Life-giving Essence, Hammer of Evolution Shard – Coma, and Light Cube. Prophet Gears have replaced the Felis Gears. 
- Nightmare Star Shop has been updated with the following items: Drakonite, Quality Drakonite, and Superb Drakonite. 
- Dragon Scale Shop has been updated with new Legendary Grade Element Conversion Gems. 
- Dragon Scale Crafting has been removed.

notes.title: Complete Patch Notes – Twisted Territory
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6564b8d6-31b1-4ff7-8594-373ee4a792cc.jpg

Read all about the latest update arriving on March 17. Visit the new Twisted Territory to take on fierce bosses and complete additional story quests! Join us for some fun events including the Dark Banquet Hall, Daily Log In, and the return of Loffy’s Dicey Dungeon. The Dragon Vault will also be updated with new goodies!

New Content 
- Twisted Territory 
- Dragon Vault Update

New Events 
- Dark Banquet Hall 
- Daily Log In Event 
- Loffy’s Dicey Dungeon

Additional Updates 
- Bug Fixes 
- UI Changes 
- NPC Changes

Twisted Territory
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-235d2633-119c-4e4f-82f7-8ce292e4f4e0.jpg

Head to the Heart of Merka in the Mistlands where you can depart to the brand-new Twisted Territory! Just as the name suggests, this place is full of twists and turns. There are six new dungeons. Enter the Twisted Fountain or Decaying Grounds dungeons, and from either of those you can then continue on to a random Lost Dominion dungeon! Take friends, or go solo. Either way you will have a wickedly warped grand old time!

In addition, you can continue the main storyline with new Apocrypha 5 quests available for Lv. 90 players. Step foot into the Twisted Territory and uncover a potential new threat to your friends and their beloved Merka!

To twist and turn, click here.

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-205394dc-7df3-4682-8a07-9abd35a3fa8c.jpg

Gerrant’s influence over the Dragon Eggs continues, with the new Ardent Gold Dragon Egg! Gather your weapons on your way to a complete Gerrant transformation.

Get an ‘A’ with new rare-grade costumes available in the Dragon Vault, and pick up a new friend with the Fluffy Casper ally! New items are also available in the Dragon Egg.

Dark Banquet Hall
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-7d0979c1-3008-4d7a-aecb-fa4f320586bf.jpg

Are you ready to test your worth? Enter the Dark Banquet Hall, and navigate your way through all 11 stages! But be prepared—tough bosses await you at three of the stages! See how far you can go in order to get the best prizes.

Daily Login Event
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-22fb2f21-3960-4072-89f4-dff1480dfaf9.jpg

Log in to Dragon Nest every day during the event period to receive the Crystal Wing, Tail, and Decal Set! If you get all three, you can also earn a Starry Ram Mount.

Loffy's Dicey Dungeon
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-a0802f3a-db88-4d26-a625-675df3a3a029.jpg

Last month there was an issue that caused this event to end early. As a result, we are re-running the event this month! Starting on Saturday, March 19, you can venture forth with Loffy as you help him find his secret treasure room!

Bug Fixes

- Various texts have been updated.

UI Changes

- Rumble Mode has been updated to Lv. 90.

NPC Changes

- NPC Blacksmiths can now craft Lv. 90 accessories.

Known Issues

- Lv. 90 Dragon Gems cannot be enhanced at this time.

Read all about the latest update arriving on February 18. Join Loffy in his quest for treasure, try out new Arena PvP game modes, and join the Unlimited Battlefield! The Dragon Vault will also be updated with new goodies!

New Content 
- Loffy’s Dicey Dungeon 
- Dragon Vault Update 
- Arena AI Game Modes 
- Unlimited Battlefield

Additional Updates 
- Bug Fixes 
- Achievement Changes 
- NPC Changes

Loffy's Dicey Dungeon
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-a0802f3a-db88-4d26-a625-675df3a3a029.jpg

Loffy’s greatest treasure hunt has begun anew! Venture forth with Loffy as you help him find his secret treasure room!

To search for treasure, click here.

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-b4ebc546-7c00-4e61-b8e1-9458ff2f858f.jpg

Some of Gerrant’s power has found its way to the Dragon Vault! Pick up rare-grade costumes to acquire the grace of Gerrant for yourself. New synthesis costumes are also available, as well as an update to items in the Dragon Egg.

Gerrant’s power has also influenced the Dragon Eggs, creating a new Gold Dragon Egg! Get the first item on your way to a complete Gerrant transformation.

Arena AI Game Modes

The King and the Duke have worked tirelessly with Belin and the Sorceress’ of the Coven to bring alternate options to the PvP Arena! Now introducing the following PvP active AI game modes: 
- Respawn (AI) 
- Rounds (AI) 
- WipeOut (AI)

In PvP AI game modes, you can join up with a team, or go solo against active AI-controlled classes. Unlike the AI classes in the Combo Practice Room, these AI classes won’t just stand there! They’re ready to fight back and give you a challenge.

Belin and the Sorceress’ of the Coven are working diligently to give you access to all of the classes, but for now only the following AI classes are available: 
- Gladiator 
- Warden 
- Ice Witch 
- Crusader 
- Gear Master 
- Spirit Dancer 
- Reaper

Try setting an AI to the highest difficulty and see if your combos stand a chance! You can also earn achievements for beating the various AI classes.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-179c7772-a8cb-4c62-b924-9ccc7f11321b.jpg

Unlimited Battlefield

The ultimate all-out brawl has appeared in Altera—the Unlimited Battlefield! You can access the field within the major field portals in Saint’s Haven. Once inside, take on five other players as you brawl against each other to see who can earn the most kills within the ten-minute time limit! Note that you cannot be in a party to enter; you can only enter solo.

But beware… hordes of monsters appear as well, and they will try to take you out. If you die, you will respawn in the battlefield. If you die three times, you will respawn with a buff that lets you deal out increased damage!

While monsters don’t count toward your kill count, defeated monsters drop items that ANYONE in the room can pick up! You need to be quick and deadly to take out monsters and acquire their items before someone else does. Get your hands on items such as an Unlimited Wellspring that grants increases to Strength, Agility, and Physical Damage!

Unlimited Battlefield Times: 
- Monday – Thursday: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM Pacific (8:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern) 
- Friday – Sunday: 12:00 AM – 2:00 AM Pacific (3:00 AM – 5:00 AM Eastern), 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM Pacific (8:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern)

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-7a526a0b-77a1-4350-95bc-01fdcb1afd5e.jpg

Bug Fixes

- Christmas costumes from NPC Santa Orc now display properly on Machina characters. 
- The Red Dragon Nest glitch has been fixed. 
- The Ice Witch “Class Master Class Skill II” now functions in PvP. 
- The “Shortcuts” quest from Carderock Pass has been removed. 
- Various texts have been updated.

Achievement Changes

- Unlimited Battlefield achievements have been added. 
- PvP AI achievements have been added.

NPC Changes

- The R-Coin Shop has been removed from NPC Cassie. 
- NPC Santa Orc has left Altera.

notes.title: Complete Patch Notes – Daidalos Nest
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6564b8d6-31b1-4ff7-8594-373ee4a792cc.jpg

Read all about the latest update arriving on January 21. Embrace your inner childhood and take on the dark creatures in Daidalos Nest! Check out the new mercenary system, a guild update, and other new systems. The Dragon Vault will also be updated with new goodies!

New Content 
- Daidalos Nest 
- Dragon Vault Update 
- Mercenary Exploration System 
- Guild Update 
- Dragon Gem Enhancement 
- Hero System 
- Damage Counter

Additional Updates 
- Bug Fixes 
- UI Changes 
- Achievement Changes 
- NPC Changes 
- Skill Changes

Daidalos Nest
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-b5d59c6a-57a4-48ff-8d9e-f66eaed1f5de.jpg

A new threat has emerged in Altera—Daidalos Nest! The mad architect Daidalos seeks to claim his place in history by trapping players within his labyrinth…forever! Can you escape the demented doctor and his toy-like monsters?

To navigate the labyrinth, click here.

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-d4bed74c-6b3e-4f38-80c0-a3a1115bd825.jpg

Get ready to go out of this world! New futuristic fashions have invaded the Dragon Vault, along with Machina hair and face styles, new hair styles for many classes, and the new Champion’s Package.

Then crack open a Dragon Egg, and see if you can find a UFO mount, a cloud spirit, and the gorgeous Blinding Constellation wing, tail, and decal set!

Mercenary Exploration System

Altera is a big world, and sometimes even the most experienced explorer doesn’t have time to see everything. Now you can send out brave mercenaries to explore the frontier for you! These mercs can complete exploration objectives on your behalf, and help you earn the riches that once graced the royals of Val Astrum.

Choose a total of 3 mercenaries; either ones you own or ones that you can rent.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-bc8c7998-e5b2-4900-937c-67b1421bf37c.jpg

Wait out the timer to receive your reward. The longer and more difficult the mission, the better chance of receiving awesome rewards!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-d0ee9134-4199-46cc-af44-9e80defc1ae1.jpg

Guild Update

The guild system has been updated to make it easier to use and level your guild! Guild EXP now turns into Guild Points (GP), which can be used to level up your guild, receive guild rewards, and more. The ‘GP Limit’ value increases as your guild level increases. Guild Points are automatically added to the guild after clearing dungeons, nests and completing guild achievements. Guild member contribution can also now be seen in the Guild window.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-7fdedf87-1d49-4436-9217-20f98c54bfd5.jpg

Guild Rewards have been streamlined so that the rewards can be viewed more easily. Most items in the ‘General’ sub-tab can be purchased by all guild members, while items in the ‘Guild Rewards’ sub-tab can only be acquired by guild members of officer level or higher.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-8be27dae-d9ac-4b21-a058-1fa92a7f0c92.jpg

Additional information: 
- The amount of points required to max out a Guild Level has been reduced. 
- The amount of points received after completing an achievement has been reduced.

The following new Guild Rewards have been added. 
- Guild Member Damage Boost: +1%/+3%/+5% 
- Guild Member Hero EXP Boost: +5%/+10%/+15% 
- Guild Point Boost: +5%/+10%/+15%

Dragon Gem Enhancement

Lv. 90 Dragon Gems can now be enhanced in much the same way that armors and weapons can be enhanced. However, the materials needed for each enhancement must be extracted from other Lv. 90 Dragon Gems. Stats that pertain to the Dragon Gem will be upgraded when enhancing the gem. Keep enhancing to find out the max level of the Dragon Gem!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-e5dc45e8-170a-4131-8330-a537db1e56a1.png

Hero System

After reaching the max level of Lv. 90, you can now earn Hero EXP when you clear a max level dungeon. This new Hero System allows you to continue leveling by an additional 50 levels! By continuing to level up, your stats and damage increase, making you stronger and ready to take on end-game content. This system is shared between all characters on a single account. The Hero Level UI has been added to the ‘Character’ window so that you can see your progress. There are limits as to how many levels you can earn on your characters, and there is a total limit to the amount of Hero EXP that your account can earn each week.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-a7717eab-6f9f-4a71-ad06-a79ae7e4b3a7.png

Damage Counter

You will now be able to see how much damage you and or your party does in a single dungeon or nest run! Use this to help analyze your attacks and make the most of your party’s run!

The damage meter information can be found in the ‘Overview’ menu (or press the ‘N’ key). In the ‘Damage’ tab, press ‘Start’ to begin recording the damage done by all party members during the dungeon or nest run. Press the ‘Stop’ button to finish the recording. The ‘Dungeon’ tab automatically records all of your damage done in all dungeons you visit during the play session. This information disappears when you log off.

Bug Fixes

- The Dark Avenger quest can be completed. 
- Various texts have been updated.

UI Changes

- NPC Portal Mages have been updated. Open your map and click on an NPC or portal to travel there instantly. 
- Tooltips have been added to the ‘Mount’, ‘Ally’, and ‘Mercenary’ tabs of the ‘Character’ window. 
- New ‘Damage Type’ text has been added in skill descriptions.

Achievement Changes

- Guild achievements have been updated. 
- Daidalos Nest achievements have been added.

NPC Changes

- The Spirit of Wintertide has left Altera. Santa Orc has stayed behind. 
- The NPC Arena Shop has been updated: Lustre’s price and purchase count has been lowered. The Hero Level EXP Potion and Epic Plate Pouch have been added. 
- NPC Sanders’ Mercenary Pouch (Rare Grade) has had its required purchase level reduced to Lv. 24. 
- NPC Blacksmith’s Technique Accessories from Lv. 24 to Lv. 70 have been removed. The Dragon Gem Enhancement system has been added.

Skill Changes

The ‘Damage Percentage Increase’ amount has been increased for the following ‘Class Mastery II’ skills. The new amounts are shown:

- Gladiator - 10% 
- Dark Avenger - 12% 
- Destroyer - 13% 
- Barbarian - 8% 
- Windwalker - 10% 
- Tempest - 10% 
- Chaos Mage - 13% 
- Ice Witch - 13% 
- Inquisitor - 13% 
- Crusader - 4% 
- Gear Master - 7% 
- Shooting Star - 10% 
- Blade Dancer - 10% 
- Soul Eater - 10% 
- Spirit Dancer - 10% 
- Raven - 12% 
- Reaper - 7% 
- Abyss Walker - 7% 
- Dragoon - 12%

notes.title: Update Preview: See What’s Coming!
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-da7826f3-65b1-4ce0-90ed-a50a547a001a.jpg

Embrace your inner childhood and take on the dark creatures in Daidalos Nest! Dragon Nest’s latest update arrives next week and includes:

Daidalos Nest

A new Level 90 nest is coming to Altera—Daidalos Nest! This dungeon is filled with toy-like monsters straight from a child’s room. But these beasts have a nightmarish twist! Grab some friends and enter this labyrinthine nest, and face the strange creatures within.

You can check out the video for Daidalos Nest here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hk9gu1viA5Y

Mercenary Mission System

Altera is a big world, and sometimes even the most experienced explorer doesn’t have time to see everything. Mercenaries are the answer! Hire mercs to explore the various dungeons and nests, completing exploration objectives for a chance to earn high level items! Each mission has a timer and difficulty setting. The longer and more difficult the mission, the better chance of receiving awesome rewards!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-f5f0d86e-6664-44f9-8f10-22d7bc1a5d64.png

Guild System Update

We've decided to amp up the new year in Dragon Nest with a brand new guild system! Guilds are getting an overhaul, with improved UI and new Guild Points! Your guild will be able to earn Guild Points which can then be used for leveling your guild. Make your guild as strong as it can be!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-d1da4074-1104-449e-806b-47db1041b6c6.png

Dragon Gem Enhancement

Dragon Gems are about to become even more useful! Now you will be able to enhance your Lv. 90 Dragon Gems in much the same way that armors and weapons can be enhanced. Give the Dragon Gem to any NPC Blacksmith and see how far you can enhance it!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-e5dc45e8-170a-4131-8330-a537db1e56a1.png

Dragon Vault Update

Check out what’s arriving next week in the Dragon Vault! Get yourself a new ‘do with new hairstyles for many classes, and pick up hair and face coupons of Machina’s character creation options so you can change her look at will. Then get ready to go out of this world! New space-themed costumes are coming, and the Dragon Eggs will also be updated with new items to match!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-5f48cfdf-acca-4470-8f7d-7ba7c84f22df.png

notes.title: Complete Patch Notes – Machina Arrives
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6564b8d6-31b1-4ff7-8594-373ee4a792cc.jpg

Read all about the latest update arriving on December 10. Welcome the newest character class, Machina! Then celebrate the festive season with Wintertide events, and see what new goodies are arriving in the Dragon Vault!

New Content 
- Machina 
- Nightmare Nest 
- Dragon Vault Update

New Events 
- Wintertide Holiday Events

Additional Updates 
- Bug Fixes 
- UI Changes 
- Dungeon Changes 
- Achievement Changes 
- NPC Changes

Machina
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-c0e2e5d3-ab59-4ab1-90ff-0fcafdc172ab.jpg

Welcome Altera’s newest character class—Machina! This girl is “armed” with a huge mechanical arm, and she utilizes the art of Steampunch to deliver brutal melee attacks. Her attacks generate “Steam” which can then be used to pull off fast-paced combo attacks to land quick and deadly blows on her enemies!

To join Machina on her adventure in Altera, click here.

Nightmare Nest
The Terminus Gateway is becoming stronger and a new nest has emerged from the power of the Monolith. The Nightmare is real, and so is the danger. Defeat enough enemies to summon a fearsome boss from one of the many nests, dungeons and story that surround the world of Altera.

- Recommended Level: Lv. 90 
- Party Size: 1 - 4 Players 
- Portal Location: Terminus Gateway in Saint’s Haven 
- Clear Count: 7 per week 
- Rewards: Nightmare Star Points 
- Shop Rewards: Pouches, Talismans, Enhancement Plates, Mercenary Pouch, Epic-Grade Armor and Weapons

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-5a46531f-d121-4305-b539-abcb1def5adb.jpg

The cold air of the North Pole has swept through the Alteran landscape and straight into the Dragon Vault. Get yourself a Jolly Wintertide Box containing the new Celestial Pegasus mount, or Frozen Sapphire wing, tail, and decal!

Then dress up as beautiful as a snowflake with new Wintertide Holiday costumes! Your human allies can dress up too. The winning costumes from the Ask SantaClick event will also be revealed!

Wintertide Holiday Events
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-3dd44fbf-babb-408a-85ca-2bb885a7256c.jpg

It would not be Wintertide without a visit from good old Santa Orc! He is back in Saint’s Haven once again, and ready to race you to the max! Do you have the holiday spirit required to beat him at his own game?

Bug Fixes
- The “Be the Storm” room has been updated for Lv. 90. 
- Lencea’s Twirl Trance EX Instant skill now deals the proper light damage. 
- Cleric’s Healing Relic skill now functions as intended.

UI Changes
- The login screen has been updated for Machina. 
- The Level Up Box no longer contains R Coins. 
- Holiday music plays in all towns.

Dungeon Changes
- Abyss-difficulty dungeons now drop Purified Approval Stamps.

Achievement Changes
- Wintertide Holiday Achievements have been added.

NPC Changes
- NPC Priestess of Darkness now sells Plate Pouch (Enhancement) in her Lament Shop. 
- NPC Count Spookula has left Altera. 
- NPC Santa Orc has appeared. 
- NPC Quartermaster Vincent has had his Ladder Shop updated.

notes.title: Complete Patch Notes – Mists of Peril
notes.notes:
Complete Patch Notes – Mists of Peril
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6564b8d6-31b1-4ff7-8594-373ee4a792cc.jpg

Read all about the latest update arriving on November 12. The level cap has increased to 90 and five new dungeons are available! Many nests have undergone changes, including the arrival of new Battle Dragon nests. Several systems have been revamped, and lots of skills have been revamped and adjusted. There are also new cash items in the Dragon Vault!

Heart of Merka
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-2588a574-6a63-4168-98c9-bb144e810b57.jpg

New town, new troubles—The opening of the Monolith has awakened the parallel dimension, which means new and powerful enemies! Travel across the dimensional rift of the Terminus Gateway to visit Heart of Merka, a parallel town that was conceived by the sister of the Goddess. Visit the five new dungeons in this area and do battle with the monsters within!

To prepare for battle, click here.

Dragon Vault Update
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-783bb17d-8f9a-4d53-bba3-cc2692bf67d9.jpg

Argenta’s influence over the Dragon Eggs continues with the last egg of the set, the new Cold-Blooded Silver Dragon Egg! Get your wing, tail, and decal and transform into Argenta herself!

 To crack open an egg, click here.

The sweet smell of roses has taken over the Dragon Vault! Go back to nature with these new rare-grade costumes and dress like a newly blossomed bud.

To see the rosy regalia, click here.

Garden of Eternity Renovation

The opening of the Monolith has generated too much power, and the Garden of Eternity has all but consumed itself. However, the implosion did not fully destroy the Garden. Some things survived, and some things were recreated.

Nests that succumbed to the implosion:
Cerberus Nest / Apocalypse Nest / Archbishop Nest / Titan Nest / Typhoon Krag Nest / Professor K Nest / Guardian Nest / Mist Nest / Volcano Nest / Arendel Trial Nest / Volcano Trial Nest / Sea Dragon Nest / Green Dragon Nest / Desert Dragon Nest / Black Dragon Nest / Dragon Expedition / Dark Banquet

Nests that survived the implosion:
Minotaur Nest / Archbishop Nest / Manticore Nest /Red Dragon Nest /Hero’s Battlefield

The Mad Spiral Ruins
The implosion has merged the Archbishop Nest and Manticore Nests! Though they are now in the same portal, they have each maintained their individual prominence.
- Recommended Level: Lv. 90
- Party Size: 1-4 Players
- Portal Location: North East Portal
- Clear Count: 3 per week
- Rewards: Epic Armor, Epic Weapons, Epic Accessories, Epic Enhancement Plates, Goddess Aura

Battle Dragon Nests

The Dragons have emerged from their lairs to pose a challenge to all those in Altera. Face off against Leviatha (Sea Dragon), Kalahan (Green Dragon), Aisha (Desert Dragon), and Pether (Black Dragon) alone if you’re strong enough—or with party. In these nests, you can engage in the boss fight immediately without having to fight through waves of lesser monsters.

- Recommended Level: Lv. 40 - Leviatha (Sea Dragon)
- Recommended Level: Lv. 50 - Kalahan (Green Dragon)
- Recommended Level: Lv. 60 - Aisha (Desert Dragon)
- Recommended Level: Lv. 70 - Pether (Black Dragon)
- Party Size: 1-4 Players 
- Portal Location: Port Hermalte - Leviatha (Sea Dragon)
- Portal Location: Liverwort Marina - Kalahan (Green Dragon)
- Portal Location: Liverwort Marina - Aisha (Desert Dragon)
- Portal Location: Arendel – Pether (Black Dragon)
- Clear Count: Unlimited
- Rewards: Plates, Armor, Accessories, Dragon Gems

Daredevil Faire Renovation

The opening of the Monolith caused some dungeons, such as the Treasure Run, to be removed. Daredevil Faire now has the following dungeons:

- Gobarta
- Gobsersia
- Gobarta Revival: The Goblin Strikes Back
- Gateway of Memories
- Secret Room (we’d give you more information, but it’s a secret).

Enhancement Transfer System

The Blacksmith NPCs can now transfer enhancement levels between armors. Here is the list of armors that can use the system:

- Lv. 80 Epic Equipment
- Lv. 80 Unique Equipment
- Lv. 90 New Epic Equipment

Bug Fixes

- Various texts have been updated.
- The Universal Ape Crests now function properly.
- The Universal Ape Crests now have the proper text.

UI Changes

- Altera has been reverted back to its original state.
- The login screen has been updated.
- The opening video has been updated.
- The mini-map has been moved to the upper-right corner of the screen.
- The skills bar UI has been re-tooled.
- All of the window UI has been updated.
- The Level Up Box from Levels 81 to 90 have been added. The Level Up Box is no longer an NX item.

Dungeon Changes

- Nests have been reset.
- The difficulty settings in the dungeon areas (Port Hermalte, Lotus Marsh, Arendel) surrounding Saint’s Haven have been adjusted to Normal and Master.
- PWR consumption is now set to 60 across all dungeons regardless of party size.

Achievement Changes

- Ladder has been reset.
- Achievements have been updated to reflect the new state of Nests.
- Already acquired achievements will not be removed.
- The Weekly Achievement Window has been updated and will go live on Saturday: Manticore Nest, Archbishop Nest, Hero’s Battlefield, and Hero’s Battlefield (Hardcore).

Crafting Changes

- Transcendent Lustres can now be crafted.
- Lv. 80 Quality Dragon Gems (Attack) have been updated to include a basic stat when crafted.

NPC Changes

- NPC Andromeda has now left Altera.
- The Quackum event has ended but NPC Cassie has stayed.
- Count Spookula has stayed in Altera.
- NPC Irine has changed back to her normal outfit.
- NPC Cassie now has the R Coins Shop.
- NPC Mocha and Rosetta now have the Goddess Aura Shop.
- NPC Honest Ed’s Achievement Shop has been removed.

Item Changes

- Dimensional Crystal Fragments have been updated. They can be placed in Shared Storage.
- Skill Crest Pouches can now be traded in the Marketplace.
- Apple Juice of Life now only works in Red Dragon Nest and Red Dragon Nest Hardcore.
- MP Recovery items have been removed from shops, titles, and various items.
- The Entry Pass for Red Dragon Nest has been removed.
- Some skill-up accessories affected by the skill revamp have been changed.
- Special Dragon Gems are no longer supported.

For a more in depth look at class changes: Click Here
